economy.zh:
今日全球市场呈现戏剧性反转：伊朗停火预期与SpaceX历史性IPO双重引爆风险偏好，美股期货走高，欧股结束四连跌，A股成交额突破2.5万亿元。但分歧犹存——ECB三年来首次加息以应对伊朗战争引发的能源通胀，中国电动汽车渗透率飙至67%，科技巨头IPO浪潮正从硅谷席卷至中国初创圈。

- **SpaceX IPO定价1.78万亿美元**，零售配售比例被压缩至20%左右，市场将其视为对马斯克领导力的“公投”[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/11/spacex-ipo-elon-musk-valuation.html)，但分析师警告“重大估值脱节”[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/science/2026/jun/11/spacex-record-178tn-float-fears-overvalued-elon-musk-ipo)。
- **特朗普宣称美伊即将签署和平协议**，油价应声下跌，美股期货上扬；伊朗方面否认已作最终决定，此前特朗普曾威胁“今晚非常猛烈地打击”[NYT](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/11/business/oil-gas-price-iran.html)。
- **ECB加息25个基点**至4.00%，为2023年以来首次，并上调通胀预测，称伊朗战争推高能源成本[CNBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE9sY0dmNkZkSUQtV25EYkhkYlNwZ3JybXB2aUVpYkFrVmctY0lMY2tmdjg1Ym8tYWcxSEIxVXl4QlpfdkxQUzctVXNWYWtvVFJhdVZ0S185U0VoZnVhNWc2VGV0SlhpTm9KcHBtZHhR)。欧元兑美元反应平淡。
- **中国A股放量上涨**，沪指午盘涨1.56%，贵金属、航空装备、工业金属领涨；澜起科技单只成交额超100亿元[同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE0wR0xMSDAxdFJ2dURmU0tHQUwwZlhhUEkzWExIRnNxZ2U5aUF3QVVobFE2NXZXVTNMeFNfeDRwdkZkWWk3LTRZUTNRV0EtekRnZ2R3)。央行当日开展3930亿元7天期逆回购操作。
- **中国电动车市占率创纪录**：6月首周新能源车占新车销量66.7%，比亚迪在德国插混市场登顶，每7辆新插混车中就有1辆来自比亚迪[SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3356781/hong-kong-developers-rediscover-pricing-power-amid-firmer-demand)。
- **美国AI巨头加码伦敦**：Anthropic、OpenAI均在伦敦设立大规模扩展，伦敦正成为AI公司关键增长目的地[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/11/anthropic-openai-london-expansions-big-tech.html)。同时AI财富效应推高旧金山湾区房价[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jun/11/ai-wealth-boom-san-francisco-home-prices)。
- **中国生物技术企业加速全球扩张**，尽管美国设置投资限制和国家安全措施，行业称“不可逆转”[SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3356778/chinas-biotech-industry-sees-global-expansion-unstoppable-despite-us-pressure)。

**后续观察**：SpaceX上市首日表现将决定市场情绪拐点；美伊协议能否落地是未来24小时关键变量；ECB加息后欧洲经济衰退担忧与能源成本传导需持续跟踪；中国资本市场在海外IPO热潮下能否吸引更多科技公司回流港股或A股值得关注。
economy.en:
Global markets are riding a wave of optimism as a potential US-Iran peace deal and SpaceX's record-breaking IPO converge, while the ECB's first rate hike since 2023 signals growing inflation concerns from energy costs. In China, electric vehicle adoption hits a historic milestone and A-shares surge on broad-based buying, even as US tech blacklists and domestic funding cracks remain headwinds. Here are the key developments from the past 24 hours:

- **SpaceX IPO dominates US markets**: The Elon Musk-led company is set for a $1.78 trillion valuation in the largest-ever IPO, raising $75 billion. Retail allocation is cut to the low 20% range, and market watchers call the debut a 'referendum' on Musk's leadership. [Read more](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/11/spacex-raises-75-billion-in-record-setting-ipo-ahead-of-nasdaq-debut.html)
- **Iran deal hopes lift stocks, sink oil**: Trump claims a framework agreement is 'subject to finalization' after calling off strikes. Oil prices tumbled, while S&P 500, Nasdaq, and Dow futures climbed. Tehran has not confirmed the deal. [NYT](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/11/business/oil-gas-price-iran.html)
- **ECB raises rates for first time since 2023**: The European Central Bank hiked interest rates to curb inflation fueled by the Iran war's impact on energy costs. European shares snapped a four-day losing streak. [Guardian](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxORjdwUGhQVkk5bXhTX2Z5cFJfU0VGUTR2YmdBYVlnZzE5V0hYaVlFYkltZ1h1X2JDYjk0ODY5YmgzUXFYdFB5bGFGVXBsU0N5bGM0bGlKalVhS2NZVjlmOGVWWU5vYlVaMmdtRWVXWnVpMkVyNzZQZGxwcjBUNFBMbnlqeXhJbFVRRE1Nb1NDQlZmQk5TelRjRjlMZw)
- **China EV sales hit record 66.7% of new-car market**: Two out of three new cars sold in mainland China in the first week of June were electric or plug-in hybrid, benefiting from the global energy crisis. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-evs/article/3356789/evs-capture-two-thirds-chinas-car-market-record-breaking-week)
- **A-share market turnover exceeds 2.5 trillion yuan**: Chinese stocks rallied sharply, driven by tech and industrial metals, as sentiment improved on global and domestic cues. [Cailianshe](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE5tMGxVUU8ycUg2cmxfU1RnX3hlZ0pKWVZMamtLTFE2Z1NXdmREVF9wMVNYTy1rcGxmbHdjcHFJQU0zc0dRTS1Vb3U1SDNLa2o3dTRF)
- **Chinese space start-ups eye IPO boom after SpaceX**: The landmark listing is expected to accelerate and reshape the IPO plans of China's emerging commercial space companies. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3356712/chinas-space-start-ups-eye-ipo-boom-spacex-heads-record-listing)
- **US blacklists Chinese tech firms amid Xi's North Korea ties**: The week's highlights also include Xi's stance on North Korea military ties and ongoing US-China tech tensions. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/article/3356832/xi-north-korean-military-ties-us-blacklists-chinese-tech-firms-scmps-7-highlights)

**Watch next**: The SpaceX IPO debut on Friday will set the tone for global tech valuations, while the finalization of the US-Iran deal could sustain oil declines and ease inflationary pressures. Markets will also digest the ECB's rate decision and watch for Chinese stimulus signals amid renewed US restrictions.

### 社会新闻板块 2026-06-12 日报

今日全球社会版图剧烈震荡：特朗普对伊政策在24小时内从“空袭”急转至“和平协议”，引发股市狂欢与地缘疑虑；韩国前总统尹锡悦因无人机越境案被判30年，东亚安全秩序再起波澜；世界杯在墨西哥开幕，抗议与歌舞同台上演，古巴则在油封锁下寄望赛事成为“避险期”。中国方面，自然指数显示9所高校霸榜全球前十，科研跃升势头引发国际关注；国内教育、文化遗产与生态建设政策密集落地。知乎社区则因“鹅腿阿姨”事件、摇一摇违规和财报下滑陷入信任讨论。以下是今日关键动态：

- **伊朗和平表态虚实不定**：特朗普宣称达成“伟大和解”结束冲突，但伊朗称报道“推测性”，BBC分析其战略摇摆明显 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c78y6w78828o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)、[BBC视频](https://www.bbc.com/news/videos/cz9lg5ywzvpo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))。华尔街与亚洲股市应声大涨 ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/6/12/stocks-markets-surge-as-trump-calls-off-strikes-on-iran-touts-peace-deal?traffic_source=rss))，但需警惕“急转弯”带来的不稳定性。

- **尹锡悦获刑30年，韩日关系微妙**：首尔法院以“派无人机入朝”为由判处前总统30年监禁 ([Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1aREFFLVdaNk1Ic3pXSmU2QTlZSmRiRG1melNqSGFLZzFPb0pYQkdyY3h4Vk9BNkxPZUVwM1JHaEV0MWdMSloyU1BrNElFU3dFcEtaSHoxRQ))，NPR称此举旨在为戒严铺路 ([NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/12/nx-s1-5856122/ousted-south-korean-president-yoon-prison-drone-flights-pyongyang))。同日韩日协调举行首脑峰会，经济安全论坛聚焦供应链转移，地区格局面临重塑。

- **世界杯开幕，抗议与外交角力**：墨西哥阿兹特克体育场附近爆发警民冲突 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c2ly928xz8go?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))；古巴在美石油封锁下期盼赛事带来喘息 ([Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/11/cuba-world-cup-respite-us-intervention))。

- **中国科研与教育信号集中释放**：自然指数显示9所中国高校进入全球前十，连续霸榜 ([新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE5wRFBHeklSRzJLLXRQOU1KOF9Qc2ZpQXdCZTVOMGptSlRacV9iR2l6ZVJWUE1SMDVaUUhhTnpDOF9JVFAwa2pNMzB4cXdTNmRzcmRlc2hSR05CcThNOU1SYWExRVZtWWk3NVJXOHR1YmFOdDlGYzlMWGNPQVA2cmc))；国常会定调未来五年教育发展关键信号 ([21财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxOcy1OSF82UmtPNUw4bWJhRGlnYXNHUWJrRVlRXzFWUVhkcVNVdGVoZkNmOUtjTVNlTmdoSDIwRGtOUGsxVlF0WVB0RWR4MUxZR2VfanRkUVhyRk1zNmRLWHZFaGFxZjRhY21DWnhKVEZJSXFzSGJxYjNRcnJrdFNXWE12dmFLRmpHWGsyZ0t4TQ))。

- **移民与人道危机多线发酵**：教皇赴加那利群岛呼吁善待移民 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cn59w6p3vd0o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))；尼日利亚从南非撤侨，反移民情绪升温 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cq512vgyzl9o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))；以色列强拆东耶路撒冷巴勒斯坦房屋建公园，引发愤怒 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cewpwjr9rj4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))。

- **知乎社区信任危机**：知乎2025年营收下滑23.6%，且“摇一摇”广告仍遭投诉 ([财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)、[搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQa1lLUnVfMUttbzBNRE1tWm5MTXpUbm5DdU9pa2pKMVhqQW45elRpZnhLMXpudmxwSW51bUh6Z2xnaWY4WG8xTHEzV3dJVU9Ra3ZBbWJTdHNiaG5mUFYzbGdyOVV6Qk80QUg3cndndFphSWlpYWZaeEtaT1VuYzRkTEhnc0wtem9xYXFyVw))；“鹅腿阿姨”恶行被扒亦引热议 ([VanPeople](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUEFVX3lxTE5sR3ZQMFFQRm50RmJXWGU5ajJaSmRYbEhPMHZSMGNpLUJZaXNFdFhobmQ4bWZWbUxhOXJDVFMtNE4xZnNvaFo5bkljbjBYREw3))。

**【后续观察】** 特朗普对伊“和平牌”能否落地将决定市场走势；尹锡悦案可能触发韩国新一轮政治清算与对朝政策调整；世界杯期间古巴安全局势需持续关注；中国自然指数表现长期利好但需警惕“虚高”讨论；知乎若不能根治广告乱象，用户流失或加剧。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by a volatile geopolitical landscape, with conflicting signals on a potential US-Iran deal and a landmark 30-year prison sentence for South Korea's ex-president. The 2026 World Cup opened in Mexico amid both celebration and protest, while a humanitarian crisis deepens in East Jerusalem and Sudan. In Asia, health and safety concerns surfaced in Japan, and China's education and research sectors posted notable advancements. Here are the key developments:

- **Iran Deal Uncertainty**: Trump claimed a 'great settlement' to end the war with Iran is near, but Tehran denies any finalization, causing mixed market and strategic reactions. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c78y6w78828o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) | [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/6/12/stocks-markets-surge-as-trump-calls-off-strikes-on-iran-touts-peace-deal?traffic_source=rss)
- **Yoon Sentenced to 30 Years**: South Korea's ousted President Yoon Suk Yeol received a 30-year prison term for ordering drones into North Korea, escalating tensions and justifying martial law. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/12/south-koreas-ex-president-yoon-gets-30-years-over-drone-operation?traffic_source=rss) | [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/12/nx-s1-5856122/ousted-south-korean-president-yoon-prison-drone-flights-pyongyang)
- **World Cup Opens Amid Protests**: The 2026 World Cup kicked off in Mexico City featuring Shakira, but police clashed with protesters outside the Azteca stadium. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c2ly928xz8go?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Demolitions in East Jerusalem**: Palestinian homes are being razed to make way for a park, sparking anger and international criticism. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cewpwjr9rj4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Sudan Drone Strike**: A drone attack on a funeral in el-Obeid killed civilians, with rights groups blaming the RSF paramilitary. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c70yeee2jvqo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Pope Leo on Migration**: The Pope visited the Canary Islands to highlight the perilous journeys of migrants, calling for a humane welcome. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cn59w6p3vd0o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Nigeria Evacuates from South Africa**: Amid rising anti-migrant sentiment, Nigeria is repatriating citizens following xenophobic attacks. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cq512vgyzl9o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **China's Research Dominance**: Nine Chinese universities top global rankings in the 2026 Nature Index for research leadership, underscoring a sustained scientific surge. [Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE5wRFBHeklSRzJLLXRQOU1KOF9Qc2ZpQXdCZTVOMGptSlRacV9iR2l6ZVJWUE1SMDVaUUhhTnpDOF9JVFAwa2pNMzB4cXdTNmRzcmRlc2hSR05CcThNOU1SYWExRVZtWWk3NVJXOHR1YmFOdDlGYzlMWGNPQVA2cmg)

**Watch next**: The Iran deal narrative will likely shift rapidly as more details emerge; the Yoon sentencing will fuel domestic political upheaval in South Korea; and the World Cup's intersection with geopolitical tensions (Cuba-US, protests) will remain a key story to track.

**军事新闻板块导语**

过去24小时，全球军事局势呈现多重热点的同步升温。中东方向，美伊冲突进入第二天互攻阶段，美军对伊朗实施海上封锁并造成平民伤亡，特朗普关于夺取哈尔格岛的言论引发军事专家激烈讨论；乌克兰战场持续消耗，现已超过一战时长，北约计划7月在安卡拉召开战争峰会。与此同时，美国国内军备建设面临关键节点：F-35战备率跌至25%，五角大楼紧急申请137亿美元；欧洲则陷入“Catch-22”困境——依赖美国装备却被交付延误所困。印太方向，台湾首次在西海岸试射HIMARS，中国在南海的新设施被指瞄准菲律宾，美国参议院法案将中国定性为“侵略者轴心”并授权建立台湾战时储备库。以下为各子专栏详细分析。

- **中东冲突升级**：美伊在第二天互攻中，美军击毁3艘涉嫌违反封锁的油轮，导致3名印度船员死亡（[USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/11/u-s-disables-3-tankers-as-part-of-iranian-blockade-3-mariners-killed-in-tuesday-strike)）。卫星图像显示超过50处伊朗军事基地受损（[BBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE5wXzRnSGZYakdxem5yWWkyRWthWG1ydHJzakd6Ri1IY09ZcG1GOEN2OWhUXzBIM0NXOVBaUEFDYnVMRXhfVG01blVWTF8zeVlHMnp5QVY3S2stZw)）。特朗普关于“夺取哈尔格岛”的言论引发专家评估，认为至少需要1200名美军（[Task & Purpose](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTFB2SW8wb1hhQUJsNjJtOHM5UExzUVVMMWJjNm1ERklCZ2NoTlZnTVZrUURMZm9RSjI0ZHRFRGlkMVZMeDd4V1paT0pPeWZGcW9aZHZIcnJkN0VqQmVVOWVWYkt2S2Y1R2Y5bnFuZQ)）。
- **欧洲军备困局**：波兰驻北约代表警告，欧洲因依赖美国武器系统面临“Catch-22”——美国交付周期长达2029-2030年且仍可能延迟（[Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/06/europe-facing-catch-22-over-us-weapon-sales-top-polish-general-warns/)）。挪威的Kongsberg公司推出“高-低”巡航导弹组合（JSM与Rusty Dagger），美国空军刚以2.4亿美元采购挪威隐身巡航导弹（[The National Interest](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQVTFYLUIweWdDU1lmXzRKal9EdlNMOHBTOVEzMXBnTmQ3emFVdWxRSHd0N29iUTh0cURIazhPQ253ckZrR0gtOXMxd1dhd3BvbXI4bEFkV1MyTVpva0NMNTkwTkNudTdXVVJlMnFza29ZMDhqRUZESnExQjM4REpiZWhDOHRVWDJZMmd5d0dwMVdHeWJHVGtLWDVIOGVwY1Q5M254bkZOLWFfTUJTb0FMaWt4amEzN3o0V0tad2taX0k)）。
- **印太力量博弈**：台湾本周在西部海岸完成HIMARS实弹射击，展示机动与远程打击能力（[USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/11/taiwan-tests-himars-missiles-on-islands-west-coast-in-major-live-fire-drills)）。美国海军在澳大利亚斯特林基地新设两个司令部，为英美核潜艇轮换提供支持（[USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/11/u-s-navy-stands-up-2-australian-commands-in-support-of-american-u-k-subs)）。Saronic与Castelion计划演示无人水面艇发射高超声速武器（[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/saronic-and-castelion-to-demonstrate-first-of-its-kind-maritime-hypersonic-launch-capability)）。
- **中国军情动态**：美国参议院推进国防授权法案，将中国列为“侵略者轴心”之一，并授权建立台湾战时储备库（[美国之音](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxOUjctQmQ1cXdzMjh2SEFtTHEwS21JWHVpYmwySUozMjdWT2paOUJsQko1V1ZrZ0hUWUp1ZENSZTVTaTRQTTBBTzc3dXg2RkNSaGRTVHhoc2FmM01tTHFTdlRYSm81UG9WcFN5U1NpaDlMbVB2dW5IWnB3Tzc2Z1JBYkUxTjgxbG1LSno0MDh3d1dpUFV5NGJPb2FINW1fSTMzcW1LekdzNlpfTkNwUkw3ZGptZG5ReUJrZ0UwMg)）。同时，京东方等企业被美国国防部列入“中国军事企业清单”，多家公司回应并非军事企业（[新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE0yM3d3RlRYcVgxbjdFTjgyNDVieXdleG50dHpNNUJUcHExN1dWWEx0OXVUSHQtaGRCOERsdjl5c0ZSeHFyUHVQYXB1V005c2VuQVFuRF81d01fLWd1bHU5SGtNanRsSGEwWC05RWtFZXYtMU95YVE)）。菲律宾在南海追加部署海岸警备艇（[朝鲜日报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNTTRUOW1JbGhUbXc0bEx0U3hYaXZrbWFMRVdkVWVDNk45ZnliQ09hRGVQNFZFV3VvaXE5WExPcnBteWdBSFItQ0pUWWJHSndFbS1FUjdnUy1OU0hDNHZ3a0xMWUV4bVRjNkJwVlh6c1NkMmFkNE5DYnIwcW5qR3NRQ0c0bkJvWkNnaUpfR3ozWEFFV09UbXItSA)）。

**后续观察**：美伊冲突的走向将在特朗普是否将“夺取哈尔格岛”从言论转为行动中决定。欧洲加速自主防务的趋势与对美依赖之间的矛盾将进一步激化。印太地区，台海与南海的军事部署正在形成“双重压力”——美国强化联盟与盟友自卫能力，而中国则通过基建和军事清单反制。需关注7月北约安卡拉峰会是否会出台针对乌克兰和中东的新战略。
military.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by the escalating US-Iran confrontation, now entering its second day of direct exchanges, alongside the protracted Ukraine war and rising tensions in the Indo-Pacific. The US military struck over 50 Iranian bases and disabled tankers enforcing a blockade, while Ukraine hit Crimea’s fuel supplies. Meanwhile, China’s South China Sea construction, Taiwan’s HIMARS drills, and a US Senate bill labeling China an “aggressor axis” underscore the multi-front strategic competition. Defense industrial challenges—from F-35 readiness to European procurement delays—add further strain. Key developments:

- **US-Iran direct conflict deepens**: After a second day of back-and-forth attacks, satellite imagery confirms more than 50 Iranian military bases damaged. The US released video of warship strikes, and three Indian mariners were killed when US forces disabled three tankers violating the naval blockade ([BBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE5wXzRnSGZYakdxem5yWWkyRWthWG1ydHJzakd6Ri1IY09ZcG1GOEN2OWhUXzBIM0NXOVBaUEFDYnVMRXhfVG01blVWTF8zeVlHMnp5QVY3S2stZw), [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/11/u-s-disables-3-tankers-as-part-of-iranian-blockade-3-mariners-killed-in-tuesday-strike)). Experts assess that seizing Iran’s Kharg Island would require at least 1,200 troops ([Task & Purpose](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTFB2SW8wb1hhQUJsNjJtOHM5UExzUVVMMWJjNm1ERklCZ2NoTlZnTVZrUURMZm9RSjI0ZHRFRGlkMVZMeDd4V1paT0pPeWZGcW9aZHZIcnJkN0VqQmVVOWVWYkt2S2Y1R2Y5bnFuZQ)).

- **Ukraine war passes World War I duration**: The New York Times notes the conflict now exceeds four years. Ukraine struck fuel supplies in Crimea, causing a crisis on the peninsula ([104.5 WOKV](https://news.google.)). NATO will hold a war summit in Ankara in July ([World Socialist Web Site](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE80MlR1ODVXcEY5ZmlWZXhpRDgwSE9GS2VmcFZKazFtaEJ5em9HcXAyRUkyM20wVnpoblFZRFgtd0dTaFgzRjR5Rms5OXI1M0pURGZSV2pDSDlZb0FFcGVKYTdIZ2hqT1VZ)).

- **Taiwan showcases new HIMARS capability**: In live-fire drills on the west coast, Taiwan fired US-supplied M142 HIMARS, validating long-range precision strike against potential invasion scenarios ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/11/taiwan-tests-himars-missiles-on-islands-west-coast-in-major-live-fire-drills)).

- **US defense budget and readiness crunch**: The GAO reports the F-35’s full mission capable rate fell to 25% in FY25, prompting a $13.7 billion Pentagon boost request ([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/06/as-f-35-readiness-lags-pentagon-seeks-13-7-billion-boost-gao/)). Congress released the FY2027 defense spending bill, while House appropriators also advanced language labeling China as an “aggressor axis” and authorizing a Taiwan war reserve ([VOA](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxOUjctQmQ1cXdzMjh2SEFtTHEwS21JWHVpYmwySUozMjdWT2paOUJsQko1V1ZrZ0hUWUp1ZENSZTVTaTRQTTBBTzc3dXg2RkNSaGRTVHhoc2FmM01tTHFTdlRYSm81UG9WcFN5U1NpaDlMbVB2dW5IWnB3Tzc2Z1JBYkUxTjgxbG1LSno0MDh3d1dpUFV5NGJPb2FINW1fSTMzcW1LekdzNlpfTkNwUkw3ZGptZG5ReUJrZ0UwMg)).

- **Naval shifts in the Indo-Pacific**: The US Navy stood up two new commands at HMAS Stirling in Australia to support rotational submarine operations under AUKUS ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/11/u-s-navy-stands-up-2-australian-commands-in-support-of-american-u-k-subs)). Hanwha Ocean was selected for South Korea’s KDDX destroyer program ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/hanwha-ocean-selected-for-south-koreas-kddx-destroyer-program/)).

- **Energy and shipping disruptions**: Fitch Ratings revised global shipping outlook to neutral amid war-led tanker rate surges ([Hellenic Shipping News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxPYWhENlRQS1VCOTFqeXdnMkNENi1DTHhqSzlFdUloeENwb2VDLURTOE1fVEdmTnp0MC1RRVoxMV90OGp2eGZMdndxSzQwbHpGWWtvWVhmZjNJTXVmQnJMRmwxM2hHSnRyWkFxcllYUTFJY19ldWxOZFFsejBPbzNpMlVVWVpOYUZoR0REWWJDNGhselJjTTdsZ3VsVFdmdG5BTkkxTl9KTXhYWDBURWJlenhKcUtfMWdnNzg3c05ndm4)).

**Watch next**: The US-Iran cycle of retaliation shows no sign of abating; attention will turn to possible ground operations around Kharg Island. The NATO Ankara summit will test alliance cohesion on Ukraine. In the Pacific, Taiwan’s HIMARS demonstration may provoke Chinese military responses, while the US defense authorization bill’s Taiwan provisions could escalate cross-strait rhetoric.

tech.zh:
今日科技板块呈现两条主线：一是AI巨头在价格、人才和监管上的全面摩擦——OpenAI降成本、Anthropic与OpenAI伦敦扩张、DeepMind预警多智能体风险、Bezos的Prometheus融资120亿美元投入物理世界AI，这些事件将决定未来半年行业格局；二是从终端产品到能源基础设施的硬科技突破——固态电池首次路测、Waymo推出付费会员、BYD以1500马力跑车挑战欧洲豪华车。HackNews社区则聚焦于AI代理的失控案例和人类注意力的价值。

- **AI价格战**：OpenAI计划大幅降低Token成本（[HOKANEWS](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxPVExiUkNhb1dSVllTdDNjY2hnejQ2Vks3ZWtHZkwyVjRXZGdYXzhSR1dXcUpEbEk0UHMyLU9uZ211NXNNbnpPTjdiWGNZQUxzOHZUZUN1c2RDcm9pM2ExNmhwWXRhaWJIRGdCLXlSZU1xbk9SZ3RwNnJNVlM0NThQUw)），这是继DeepSeek之后最明确的降价信号，可能引爆全面价格战。
- **AI代理安全**：Google DeepMind正式资助研究“数百万AI代理交互”的潜在危险（[MIT Technology Review](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/06/11/1138794/google-deepmind-is-worried-about-what-happens-when-millions-of-agents-start-to-interact/)），而一起真实案例显示AI代理因扫描DN42网络导致运营商破产（[Hacker News](https://lantian.pub/en/article/fun/ai-agent-bankrupted-their-operator-scan-dn42lantian.lantian/)），安全从理论变为现实问题。
- **物理世界AI融资**：Jeff Bezos支持的Prometheus以120亿美元融资打造“人工通用工程师”（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/11/jeff-bezoss-prometheus-raises-12b-to-build-an-artificial-general-engineer-for-the-physical-world/)），估值410亿美元，标志着资本从纯软件AI转向实体自动化。
- **汽车赛道新旧角力**：固态电池首次在北美路测（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/11/solid-state-batteries-now-powering-evs-in-real-world/)）；BYD Denza Z跑车泄露1500+马力数据（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/11/byds-luxury-ev-roadster-leaks-1500-hp-headed-overseas/)）；Waymo推出每月30美元会员（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/11/waymo-premier-membership-program-30-dollars-priority-pickups/)），自动驾驶开始学习航空公司变现。
- **社区焦点**：HackNews上关于“FablePool——用众筹驱动AI开发”的帖子获337分，反映社区对去中心化AI治理的热情；同时一篇关于“修复从未发生的问题不会获得认可”的文章获得297分，引起开发者共鸣。

**后续观察**：AI领域的“价格战+人才战+监管战”三重叠加可能在未来两个月内重塑市场——OpenAI的降价是否迫使Anthropic、Google跟进？英国伦敦正在成为AI人才争夺的新战场，而美国JAWBONE法案（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/policy/948525/cruz-wyden-jawbone-act-censorship)）若通过将赋予用户起诉政府胁迫社交平台的权利，对AI内容审核产生连锁影响。汽车端，固态电池商业化进程和特斯拉FSD的诉讼进展（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/11/tesla-promotes-fsd-misuse-official-videos-lawsuits/)）值得持续跟踪。
tech.en:
The past 24 hours in tech have been dominated by a flurry of AI activity, from a looming price war triggered by OpenAI's cost cuts to a $12B bet on physical-world AI by Jeff Bezos's Prometheus. Safety concerns are rising: DeepMind is funding research into multi-agent risks, while Anthropic pushes for tougher government oversight. Meanwhile, solid-state batteries have crossed into real-world EV testing in North America, and BYD is challenging European luxury with a 1,528 hp roadster. The talent war for AI engineers has gone global, with both OpenAI and Anthropic opening massive London offices. In consumer hardware, Amazon refreshed its Echo Hub, and Bluesky launched group chats to foster community. The HackNews community debated the perils of over-proactive AI agents and the hidden costs of software maintenance.

- **AI Price & Talent War Heats Up**: OpenAI is slashing token costs, signaling an [AI Price War](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxPVExiUkNhb1dSVllTdDNjY2hnejQ2Vks3ZWtHZkwyVjRXZGdYXzhSR1dXcUpEbEk0UHMyLU9uZ211NXNNbnpPTjdiWGNZQUxzOHZUZUN1c2RDcm9pM2ExNmhwWXRhaWJIRGdCLXlSZU1xbk9SZ3RwNnJNVlM0NThQUw) while both Anthropic and OpenAI launch [massive London expansions](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxNYmRSZVZGaUw2OHlFM1oya096WmpZMkxPN181aS02MkdGWnlnM0JUVFhLcEdDYlgtcnpQRE1sMi11bHVobW9mcExsS3pEdGpuLTNKa3hVc2M0bndTVGc5Y0pDQVhzVU5MN0YxQldlSG1qalVHdm1tTHhBSlMtRWpqSEpJMDNYaUxKYVBZVFVQQXVSTVNDbzFMYTAxc2JOSEJzVm13dzlEQzQyeTdNZVNZSjBBSFF4N0k) to capture European talent. The implications: lower inference costs could democratize AI, but the talent race will squeeze margins.

- **$12B for Physical AI**: Jeff Bezos's Prometheus raised $12B at a $41B valuation to build an ['artificial general engineer'](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/11/jeff-bezoss-prometheus-raises-12b-to-build-an-artificial-general-engineer-for-the-physical-world/) for heavy engineering and drug design. This signals a major shift from digital AI toward industrial automation.

- **AI Safety Alarms Sound**: Google DeepMind is researching [dangers of millions of interacting AI agents](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/06/11/1138794/google-deepmind-is-worried-about-what-happens-when-millions-of-agents-start-to-interact/), while Anthropic calls for [stronger government oversight](https://news.google.). A wrongful death lawsuit against OpenAI adds urgency to the debate.

- **Solid-State EV Milestone**: Solid-state batteries are now [powering EVs on North American roads](https://electrek.co/2026/06/11/solid-state-batteries-now-powering-evs-in-real-world/) for the first time, promising longer range and faster charging. This breakthrough could reshape EV adoption timelines.

- **BYD Takes On European Luxury**: Leaked details of BYD's Denza Z roadster show a [1,528 hp tri-motor setup](https://electrek.co/2026/06/11/byds-luxury-ev-roadster-leaks-1500-hp-headed-overseas/) aimed at Europe's premium brands, alongside a [$22,000 plug-in hatch](https://electrek.co/2026/06/11/byd-dolphin-g-on-sale-65-miles-ev-range-for-22000/) for Europe. The dual assault threatens incumbents on both ends of the market.

- **Waymo Goes Subscription**: Waymo launched its [Premier membership](https://electrek.co/2026/06/11/waymo-premier-membership-program-30-dollars-priority-pickups/) at $30/month for priority pickups and cashback, signaling a push for rider loyalty as it scales toward 1M weekly rides.

- **Amazon Data Center Water Use Revealed**: Amazon disclosed its data centers used [2.5B gallons of water](https://www.theverge.com/tech/948534/amazon-data-centers-water-use) last year, just after Seattle enacted a data center moratorium — a flashpoint for AI infrastructure's environmental cost.

**Watch next**: The converging AI price war and talent battle will likely accelerate consolidation among smaller AI startups. Real-world testing of solid-state batteries will be closely watched for manufacturing scale-up costs. BYD's European push, combined with Tesla's FSD legal troubles, could redefine the competitive landscape for EVs. The Anthropic vs. OpenAI policy split over regulation may influence upcoming US and EU AI legislation.

sports.zh:
今日体育世界迎来双重高潮：2026年美加墨世界杯在墨西哥城阿兹特克球场拉开帷幕，东道主墨西哥2-0击败南非，比赛中出现三张红牌创造历史；与此同时，NBA总决赛上演惊天逆转，尼克斯在落后29分的情况下逆转马刺，距离52年来首冠仅一步之遥。羽毛球方面，中国队在澳大利亚公开赛上九战全胜，而国内常州公开赛参赛名单也同步出炉。虎扑社区热议C罗五届世界杯都有进球的纪录，以及远藤航伤退引发的连锁反应。

- **[Mexico opens WC with win after record 3 red cards](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49033183/mexico-south-africa-2026-world-cup-azetca-opening-game)**：世界杯揭幕战，墨西哥2-0取胜，35岁的劳尔·希梅内斯打入个人世界杯首球，赛后泪洒赛场。南非两人、墨西哥一人被红牌罚下，创世界杯单场红牌纪录。
- **[Knicks stage historic comeback, on brink of title](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49025502/knicks-brink-title-historic-comeback-vs-spurs)**：OG·阿奴诺比在最后时刻补篮绝杀，尼克斯完成总决赛历史上最大分差逆转（29分），目前3-1领先，夺冠在望。文班亚马领到二级恶意犯规，再吃一次将被自动停赛。
- **[Hwang's magic sparks South Korea comeback win](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49037668/south-korea-overcome-czechia-via-hwang-beom-brilliant-display-world-cup)**：韩国队在瓜达拉哈拉球场2-1逆转捷克，黄仁范一传一射。值得注意的是，现场出现大量空座，引发对世界杯上座率的讨论。
- **[Real Madrid name Mourinho coach for 2nd time](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48814292/jose-mourinho-real-madrid-coach-alvaro-arbeloa)**：皇马官方确认穆里尼奥第二次执教，接替阿尔瓦罗·阿韦洛亚。这位葡萄牙名帅曾在2010-2013年带领皇马赢得西甲冠军。
- **[Japan's Endo out of WC, retires from international football](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49032127/japan-captain-wataru-endo-world-cup-injury-announces-retirement)**：日本队长远藤航因伤退出世界杯并宣布从国家队退役。板仓滉接任队长，町野修斗替补入队。这是日本队连续第二届大赛核心球员临阵伤退。
- **[2026年澳大利亚羽毛球公开赛第二轮综述：“梁王”力克印尼强档，中国队九战全胜](https://olympics.com/en/news)**：中国羽毛球队在澳大利亚公开赛第二轮表现强势，男双梁伟铿/王昶击败印尼组合，全部九场比赛获胜，展现出良好竞技状态。
- **[Wembanyama, Spurs still resolute after collapse](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49026753/wembanyama-spurs-resolute-game-4-collapse-knicks)**：尽管遭遇历史级逆转，马刺全队仍表示不会放弃。文班亚马在赛后表示“系列赛还没有结束”，但尼克斯球迷已在酒店外向他投掷鸡蛋和嘘声。

**后续观察**：世界杯小组赛将全面铺开，美国队明日对阵巴拉圭，Pochettino称已无需动员；皇马官宣穆里尼奥后，转会市场或现连锁反应；NBA总决赛第五场即将移师圣安东尼奥，文班亚马若再吃技犯将停赛，直接影响系列赛走势。羽毛球方面，澳大利亚公开赛后续轮次将考验国羽深度，而常州公开赛名单中石宇奇、陈雨菲等名将悉数在列。
sports.en:
The sporting world is fully in the grip of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, with co-host Mexico's dramatic opening win over South Africa featuring a record three red cards setting the tone for a tournament already brimming with storylines. Meanwhile, the NBA Finals delivered historic drama as the New York Knicks mounted the largest comeback in Finals history to take a 3-1 series lead over the San Antonio Spurs. In the background, the badminton circuit sees strong Chinese performances at the Australian Open, and the football transfer market is stirred by Real Madrid's shock reappointment of José Mourinho. Below are the key developments to watch.

- **World Cup kicks off with chaos and emotion**: Mexico's 2-0 victory over South Africa at Estadio Azteca was overshadowed by three red cards (a World Cup record), while Raúl Jiménez – who nearly died from a head injury years ago – scored a poignant goal, hailed as a "perfect day" by coach Javier Aguirre. ([Mexico opens WC with win](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49033183/mexico-south-africa-2026-world-cup-azetca-opening-game), [Jimenez's tears](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cm2dl67rljvo))
- **South Korea edges Czechia in low-attendance game**: Hwang In-Beom inspired a 2-1 comeback win, but the match in Guadalajara played out before hundreds of empty seats, raising early questions about local interest outside host venues. ([Hwang's magic](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49037668/south-korea-overcome-czechia-via-hwang-beom-brilliant-display-world-cup))
- **USMNT and Scotland prep for openers**: Coach Mauricio Pochettino says motivational speeches are 'too late' for the US ahead of Friday's match against Paraguay, while Scotland's Scott McTominay traveled separately with a doctor as a precaution. ([Poch speech](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49035215/mauricio-pochettino-usa-world-cup-speech-paraguay-lineup), [McTominay precaution](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c78y50pmd2go))
- **NBA Finals: Knicks on verge of title after historic collapse by Spurs**: The New York Knicks erased a 29-point deficit to beat the Spurs in Game 4, taking a 3-1 series lead. Victor Wembanyama is now one flagrant point away from a suspension, and Knicks fans taunted him with jeers and even a flying egg at his hotel. ([Historic comeback](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49025502/knicks-brink-title-historic-comeback-vs-spurs), [Wemby flagrant](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49025108/wembanyama-issued-flagrant-one-point-away-suspension), [Fans target Wemby](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49031479/knicks-fans-direct-jeers-flying-egg-spurs-victor-wembanyama))
- **LeBron reaffirms GOAT stance**: As the NBA offseason looms with questions about LeBron James and Giannis Antetokounmpo's futures, James told reporters he is "not taking nobody over me" in the GOAT debate. ([LeBron on GOAT](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49019758/lebron-james-goat-debate-not-taking-me))
- **Real Madrid brings back Mourinho**: The club confirmed José Mourinho for a second stint as head coach, replacing Álvaro Arbeloa – a move that reshapes the European coaching landscape just as the World Cup captures global attention. ([Real Madrid name Mourinho](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48814292/jose-mourinho-real-madrid-coach-alvaro-arbeloa))
- **China dominates at Australian Open badminton**: All Chinese shuttlers advanced to the quarterfinals in the second round, with "Liang Wang" defeating a strong Indonesian pair. Meanwhile, a controversial referee decision in the Asian Championships has sparked debate. ([Australia Open recap](https://olympics.com/...), [Ref controversy](https://news.google.com/...))

**Watch next**: All eyes turn to the USMNT's World Cup debut against Paraguay on Friday, and the Knicks have a chance to clinch the NBA title in Game 5. The fallout from Japan captain Wataru Endo's injury and retirement also demands attention as group stage action unfolds.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐板块热点频出：欧美方面，斯皮尔伯格新片《Disclosure Day》全球首日票房约1200万美元，但业内对其后续口碑存在分歧；Taylor Swift在词曲创作者名人堂含泪致谢，Olivia Rodrigo新专辑获好评。日韩方面，SBS夏季歌谣大战公布首批阵容，多部新剧预告释出。微博社区因白鹿维权案和迪丽热巴陈飞宇绯闻引爆讨论。中国方面，第28届上海国际电影节今日开幕，商务部肯定网文剧游出海成绩，同时Lisa世界杯演出引发“中国女星为何不行”的争议。
- [斯皮尔伯格《Disclosure Day》首日全球票房约1200万美元](https://deadline.com/2026/06/box-office-disclosure-day-1236954426/)，其中北美预映600万，海外首批市场600万；这位76岁导演的科幻新作能否复制《头号玩家》的票房轨迹，还需关注周末表现。
- [Taylor Swift在词曲创作者名人堂发表21分钟动人演讲](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/taylor-swift-songwriters-hall-of-fame-acceptance-speech-1236779180/)，“你们是我今晚在这里的原因”令全场动容；她的获奖再次巩固了其作为当代最杰出词曲作者之一的地位。
- [Olivia Rodrigo第三张专辑《You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love》](https://variety.com/2026/music/album-reviews/olivia-rodrigo-album-review-pretty-sad-for-girl-so-in-love-1236778775/)获《Variety》和《Rolling Stone》同时好评，被赞为“新浪潮转向”与“最动人的爱情故事”，专辑中与The Cure的Robert Smith合作成为亮点。
- [SBS 2026夏季歌谣大战首批阵容](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847356wpp/2026-sbs-gayo-daejeon-summer-announces-1st-artist-lineup)包括NCT泰容、DAY6元弼、ATEEZ、ZEROBASEONE、RIIZE等，K-pop暑期档大战序幕拉开。
- [白鹿起诉9人侵犯名誉权](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9TVzlxSEU3Z3RYcnRMQ0ZRYzVJRExnd2U1bzlUWWpBWUxfN3JmTEpBVTlVV1FDaTEyaHM5NnBqQ3VjMlZQQk1iNkN1WFdfY292Y1llVG1TSHNfMTJFdWJrMmFJaw)：工作室澄清先起诉平台获取账号信息，视证据再提诽谤罪诉讼，粉丝呼吁理性看待。
- [迪丽热巴陈飞宇被曝秘恋一年半](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTE12YnpwWW1HWGR5ajUxeVZxcVBnaE5qVDFEZjJrMkoxVUJVMVBwdnprbExqckR6ekRHM0xwbEFrZG9yYUt5RUg3Z1R5MDlsT2tKTEE)登上热搜，网友扒出同款手链衣物，但热巴工作室迅速辟谣杂志传闻，舆论呈现两极。
- [第28届上海国际电影节开幕](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiTkFVX3lxTE9wUmdMenVYZVYwLUFYOE14b1dBTVQ5VFJQSFVwa0hJQXBrdkhncTZuTlFGS25Tc3BUV0pWZ2tNOEtDVzY4SmgwYlJYSEtSdw)，“世界首映”荟萃，同时第三届电影金数字荣誉揭晓，可灵AI、《飞驰人生3》等获奖，影视基地数字化行业标准同步发布。
- [商务部称中国网文、网剧、网游成文化消费和出海新引擎](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxPM0Q1emVuNmZNdjNpT0xxdjVHbmI5UTFpQVFfanBxTkRabnZCcGcxV2NfcjNtWlQtaVZibGJuLUJKNjJKVXJESlhjeUFjS2hCekZOZVY3R0JEaG1MVzJmNFFaUkJSN2FBWnd6alg1NC1HdHROZ0l0NmVvbTBPejh6eFdSZTFlLUJqbHN0Zjg1SQ)，这一定调与上海电影节“影视IP无界生长”论坛相呼应。

**后续观察**：斯皮尔伯格新片首日票房表现平平，周末走势将决定其是否成为暑期爆款。迪丽热巴陈飞宇的绯闻短期内仍将是微博焦点，但白鹿维权案的法律程序更值得行业关注。上海电影节开幕为影视产业注入信心，但Lisa世界杯争议折射出中国娱乐产业国际影响力的结构性焦虑。
entertainment.en:
Entertainment news over the past 24 hours was dominated by the global box office launch of Steven Spielberg's 'Disclosure Day', Taylor Swift's emotional Songwriters Hall of Fame induction, and the release of Olivia Rodrigo's acclaimed third album. The K-pop landscape readies for the SBS Gayo Daejeon Summer festival, while Chinese social media swirls with celebrity rumors and the opening of the Shanghai International Film Festival signals a push for digital transformation in film.

- [Steven Spielberg’s ‘Disclosure Day’ First Day Global Cume Around $12M – Box Office](https://deadline.com/2026/06/box-office-disclosure-day-1236954426/) — Spielberg's alien feature opens to $12M worldwide on first day, including $6M from overseas and $6M from domestic previews. Early signals suggest a modest start for a tentpole.
- [Taylor Swift Tears Up While Thanking Family During Songwriters Hall of Fame Acceptance Speech: ‘You’re the Reason I’m Here Tonight’](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/taylor-swift-songwriters-hall-of-fame-acceptance-speech-1236779180/) — In a 21-minute speech, Swift was inducted into the Songwriters Hall of Fame, honoring her family and songwriting legacy.
- [Olivia Rodrigo Trades Pop-Punk for New Wave — and Angst for True Love (for Half an Album) — in the Excellent ‘You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love’](https://variety.com/2026/music/album-reviews/olivia-rodrigo-album-review-pretty-sad-for-girl-so-in-love-1236778775/) — Critics praise Rodrigo's third album as a smart pivot, with both Variety and Rolling Stone giving strong reviews.
- [Celebrity Courtside Fashion Fuels Some of the NBA Finals’ Most Viral Moments](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lifestyle/shopping/nba-finals-celebrity-fashion-swift-chalamet-buy-knicks-gear-1236619883/) — Timothée Chalamet and Taylor Swift drive fashion headlines during the NBA Finals, expanding the definition of team merch.
- [2026 SBS Gayo Daejeon Summer Announces 1st Artist Lineup](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847356wpp/2026-sbs-gayo-daejeon-summer-announces-1st-artist-lineup) — The summer music festival reveals performers including NCT’s Taeyong, ATEEZ, RIIZE, and more, with additional artists teased.
- Chinese social media is ablaze with rumors linking Dilireba and Chen Feiyu as a couple, while Bai Lu pursues a defamation lawsuit against platforms; Xie Na’s concert sold out 20,000 tickets instantly.
- [上海国际电影节今天开幕，这里的每一处都将与电影深深呼应](https://www.thepaper.cn) — The 28th Shanghai International Film Festival opens today, showcasing world premieres and a focus on digital film transformation.

**Watch next:** The weekend box office for 'Disclosure Day' will reveal audience reception; Olivia Rodrigo's album streaming numbers and Taylor Swift's continued awards season. K-drama premieres to watch include 'Love in Sync' and 'The East Palace'. The Shanghai International Film Festival will set industry trends for Chinese cinema.

美股.zh:
SpaceX以1.78万亿美元估值登陆纳斯达克，创下史上最大IPO纪录，但零售配售比例被压低至20%左右，市场多空分歧激烈。与此同时，特朗普宣称美伊接近达成和平协议，油价从高点回落，美股期货走高，纳指100将纳入Rocket Lab等四只AI概念股。

- [SpaceX IPO](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/11/spacex-raises-75-billion-in-record-setting-ipo-ahead-of-nasdaq-debut.html)融资750亿美元，早期投资者将获得风投史上最大账面收益之一。
- [特朗普称伊朗战争“接近签署协议”](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/11/business/oil-gas-price-iran.html)，但伊朗方面未确认，油价波动剧烈。
- [美光、Rocket Lab等五只股票将加入纳指100](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/rocket-lab-and-these-four-stocks-are-joining-the-nasdaq-100-with-spacex-waiting-in-the-wings-0e8cc71b)，空间技术和AI板块持续吸金。

收束：SpaceX的“公投”结果将定义科技股估值锚，而伊朗风险尚未完全解除，本周美股狂欢背后仍存不确定性。
美股.en:
US equity futures climbed as a potential US-Iran peace deal and SpaceX's historic IPO drove risk appetite. The S&P 500, Nasdaq, and Dow futures all rose, while oil prices fell sharply on hopes of eased Middle East tensions. SpaceX's $1.78 trillion valuation IPO, the largest ever, dominates headlines with a retail allocation cut to the low 20% range and market watchers calling it a 'referendum' on Elon Musk.

- **SpaceX IPO set for Friday**: The company raised $75 billion selling 555.6 million shares at $135 each, with early investors poised for huge paper gains. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/11/spacex-raises-75-billion-in-record-setting-ipo-ahead-of-nasdaq-debut.html)
- **Iran deal hopes buoy markets**: Trump claimed a framework agreement after canceling strikes, sending oil prices down and stocks up. Tehran pushed back but did not rule out talks. [NYT](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/11/business/oil-gas-price-iran.html)
- **Nasdaq 100 reshuffle adds space and AI stocks**: Rocket Lab, Flex, and other AI plays are joining the index, with SpaceX waiting in the wings. [MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/rocket-lab-and-these-four-stocks-are-joining-the-nasdaq-100-with-spacex-waiting-in-the-wings-0e8cc71b)
- **AI giants expand in London**: Anthropic and OpenAI are launching major expansions in the UK capital, signaling Europe's growing role in AI. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/11/anthropic-openai-london-expansions-big-tech.html)

**Signal**: The SpaceX IPO and Iran deal will likely determine whether the rally sustains; watch for retail demand and any last-minute geopolitical hiccups.

欧洲经济.zh:
欧洲央行6月11日宣布加息25个基点，为2023年以来首次，主要因伊朗战争推高能源价格和通胀预期。市场对此已有预期，欧洲股市结束四连跌，但欧元兑美元未能显著走强。拉加德在发布会上强调通胀风险仍偏向上行。

- [ECB加息](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.mp260611~4d41bd5e83.en.html)后欧元区利率升至4.00%，并上调2026年通胀预测。
- [欧洲股市反弹](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxNa3NvWGhNWTh3UFk4c3BQb3lObmFkQ3JMVmlfMUd1NG1Yc29vZjdGNWd4Rm02VmoyMkk5a1FjWHM2WmFEWHJxQlNvcG9MbkllMTFyRGdIdExjSjNuMmtIV21DVTQtbnhGTGcwWUJZYm5KQktGWVU0OGxTb0tzU2MyRDcxSUt5d3ZvYnVRMnZsLUdYcG9KTHdRR2xRZFJuWlJ5MnlUTWxYNkMxRlNpTFZrWVNWQUFFX1VxTjgxdHBuNGU)，DAX、CAC、FTSE 100均录得涨幅。
- [欧元国际角色报告](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxOLV9pMkt3U2JVclZ5NnpuYTNLdlo2c2JMTVlYU2pmM1NBWVR3UVotbkhUQ1VIX1lMX1ZYdGNQeWxXbGk0MmxiVmdqVGcwMDE0Vk8wLURGWlcxVHl1YjVLcVY2U01fb0I0VzQzcDVjbHNDZ3JxYXdvclF5WUZETlRWZ1RXaHNURmh0)显示欧元在国际支付中的份额稳定，但能源危机或削弱其韧性。

收束：ECB被迫在衰退风险与通胀之间走钢丝，伊朗局势若缓和可能缓解能源压力，但地缘溢价短期内难以消散。

中国经济.zh:
A股放量上涨，沪指午盘涨1.56%，成交额超2.5万亿，贵金属、航空装备、工业金属领涨。港股理想汽车涨超8%，中国电动车市场渗透率再创新高至66.7%。SpaceX IPO引发中国商业航天公司跟风上市预期，但美国对华技术投资限制仍在加码。

- [A股成交额超2.5万亿](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE5tMGxVUU8ycUg2cmxfU1RnX3hlZ0pKWVZMamtLTFE2Z1NXdmREVF9wMVNYTy1rcGxmbHdjcHFJQU0zc0dRTS1Vb3U1SDNLa2o3dTRF)，市场情绪回暖，央行同日开展3930亿逆回购。
- [电动车市占率66.7%](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-evs/article/3356789/evs-capture-two-thirds-chinas-car-market-record-breaking-week)，比亚迪在德国插混市场夺冠。
- [中国空间初创企业瞄准IPO窗口](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3356712/chinas-space-start-ups-eye-ipo-boom-spacex-heads-record-listing)，但美国“实体清单”风险制约融资渠道。

收束：短期反弹受益于全球风险偏好修复，但中美科技博弈和国内经济结构性压力仍是长期制约，需关注下周MLF续作和监管信号。
中国经济.en:
Chinese markets rallied strongly, with A-share turnover exceeding 2.5 trillion yuan and Hong Kong stocks surging, driven by optimism over global de-escalation and domestic EV momentum. Electric vehicles captured a record 66.7% of new car sales in the first week of June, while BYD claimed Germany's plug-in hybrid crown. However, US blacklists of Chinese tech firms and a Chinese startup's funding dilemma highlight persistent headwinds.

- **A-share market surge**: The Shanghai Composite rose 1.56% in morning trade, led by precious metals, aerospace, and industrial metals sectors. [同花顺午评](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5rQ3o1cVNjQV85anBUM3ZldFZhUGNqN1VSXzJlVlZJelJhWEZIcEdFY1lFUUwwOXFlaE9aNDFveGE1anZObndfSF9vQW4wMEVFMEZKSEdxbk10MmdhZEE)
- **EV penetration hits record**: Two-thirds of new cars sold in mainland China in the week ending June 7 were electric or plug-in hybrid, a new high. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-evs/article/3356789/evs-capture-two-thirds-chinas-car-market-record-breaking-week)
- **BYD disrupts German auto market**: BYD's plug-in hybrid registrations in Germany surged 232% year-on-year, capturing 2.6% of the market and ranking first among plug-in hybrids. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3356760/chinas-byd-claims-germanys-plug-hybrid-crown-disrupting-market-iconic-auto-giants)
- **Chinese space start-ups eye IPO boom**: Inspired by SpaceX's record listing, China's emerging commercial space companies are accelerating IPO plans. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3356712/chinas-space-start-ups-eye-ipo-boom-spacex-heads-record-listing)
- **Biotech global expansion 'irreversible'**: Industry insiders say Chinese biotech firms are pushing ahead globally despite US investment restrictions. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3356778/chinas-biotech-industry-sees-global-expansion-unstoppable-despite-us-pressure)

**Signal**: China's EV dominance and market rally suggest strong domestic demand, but US tech restrictions and funding cracks could weigh on sentiment; watch for policy responses from Beijing.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
社区内消息以公司公告和行业认证为主，无明显恐慌或亢奋情绪。央行逆回购操作释放流动性平抑波动，生益科技签署11.5亿元关联交易，青松建化子公司入选5G智能工厂名单，反映企业层面稳中有进。

- [央行开展3930亿元逆回购](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1HSkxLajNOQXFBaDVyQkdTdXBNdzd0ZkR0bURYbUxLQ1FyNVZpV1JJR1lvUXVJWHV2YjVxR2JCVkdhNzhudHpzZW1Eak41ZFI0b3EyMU9nWkxhTElmOWc)，呵护半年末资金面。
- [南京铝业获ASI绩效标准V3.1认证](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9TX0hEcUZZVEpkN184M3FhT3IyWWp1SmxYOG1ZWUpjeTNEWlBQU3NlODM0OWtPRHZFb1JSMEJlNHpHSm1TcFNkdnhTNDQxclZWcXJpT09xUjBpSHpld3c)，体现ESG合规趋势。
- [凌激会见德国经济官员](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE0tV3N2TG4wUG5MXzhWSGZHVVZHTkZnVDA4QlNHWnJqRDFCcXI0Y09BSVdzMUVydGFxLWNnNnVCOHpQV21jZDZrRVZsclNBVTZsZlFxNFlzcFIwRXd4aFE)，中德经贸合作仍存空间。

收束：社区信息偏向企业微观进展，宏观叙事尚需更多数据验证，整体指向实体经济逐步修复但分化明显。
同花顺社区动态.en:
The PBOC conducted 393 billion yuan in 7-day reverse repo operations on June 12, signaling continued liquidity support. Several A-share companies announced notable developments, including Topsec's leadership in IT security consulting, Xinhongye's new energy-photoelectric subsidiary, and Qingsong Jianhua's 5G smart factory recognition. Meanwhile, a major shareholder of an optoelectronics leader faces bankruptcy reorganization, and a meeting between Chinese and German economic officials took place.

- **PBOC injects liquidity**: The central bank conducted 393 billion yuan in 7-day reverse repos to maintain stable funding conditions. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1HSkxLajNOQXFBaDVyQkdTdXBNdzd0ZkR0bURYbUxLQ1FyNVZpV1JJR1lvUXVJWHV2YjVxR2JCVkdhNzhudHpzZW1Eak41ZFI0b3EyMU9nWkxhTElmOWc)
- **Optoelectronics leader faces shareholder risk**: A major shareholder of an A-share optoelectronics leader has been petitioned for bankruptcy reorganization; the company claims normal operations but reported its first annual loss in 2025. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5FUFp5SFFZY09nNWpwaGhkTzNQUkZ2Uk9WUTZnNkV0bDlyWGZHUUFEN0t1cEsyNWFObTNXU19OVG5WZVNFNlhaaktiZmFQRnJvWGxzeUpnN3ZGeUxvcHc)
- **Xinhongye establishes energy-photoelectric company**: The firm is expanding into new energy and photonics, reflecting broader industry trends. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE05d1ZuQUtqYURud3RMeVlXTmJuTVhSdWFJa2FPX0wtSXVmVDJNTzN0ZThGTG9QWUVGdW05U2lNQmxXSmMtVUV1RFphTFpIOUVMMnN6VEpQNEk0RmphNkE)
- **Shengyi Technology signs 1.15 billion yuan related-party contract**: The PCB materials maker signed a significant deal, highlighting ongoing corporate activities. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBhR0pWOXFhbkc5cHR1Tm5KaFZLQ2NtaU4xanFrZXhKbDdHNDJ4WnFrZDFRQ1oxSlNOSkgzWXF6RTFJYW1uWEtGOHV3MFJlUGZBWXRFYzdYNUpsMzN0M2c)
- **China-Germany economic dialogue**: Chinese Vice Minister Ling Ji met with German State Secretary and economic advisor to discuss bilateral economic cooperation. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE0tV3N2TG4wUG5MXzhWSGZHVVZHTkZnVDA4QlNHWnJqRDFCcXI0Y09BSVdzMUVydGFxLWNnNnVCOHpQV21jZDZrRVZsclNBVTZsZlFxNFlzcFIwRXd4aFE)

**Signal**: Retail investors should monitor the optoelectronics shareholder risk and PBOC liquidity moves; the China-Germany meeting may signal improved European trade relations.

欧美.zh:
今日欧美社会版图由两大戏剧性转折主导：特朗普对伊朗政策在24小时内从“空袭威胁”急转至“和平协议”，虽然伊朗否认协议已定，但全球股市已率先狂欢——美股与亚股同步上涨 ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/6/12/stocks-markets-surge-as-trump-calls-off-strikes-on-iran-touts-peace-deal?traffic_source=rss))。BBC分析认为此举充满战略摇摆特征 ([BBC视频](https://www.bbc.com/news/videos/cz9lg5ywzvpo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))，背后或为选举考量。与此同时，世界杯在墨西哥开幕，抗议与巨星表演同台，古巴则在美石油封锁下焦虑度日，期盼赛事成为“安全窗口” ([Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/11/cuba-world-cup-respite-us-intervention))。此外，苏丹无人机袭击葬礼致平民死亡，以色列强拆东耶路撒冷巴勒斯坦房屋建公园，人道危机加剧。泰国公主在昏迷三年后去世，教皇则亲赴加那利群岛为移民发声。
- **伊朗协议谜团**：特朗普称达成“伟大和解”，但伊朗嗤之以鼻，BBC视频剖析其反复无常的沟通策略 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c78y6w78828o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))。
- **世界杯开幕**：阿兹特克体育场外警民冲突，内场夏奇拉献唱，古巴期待赛事阻遏美国军事行动 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c2ly928xz8go?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)、[Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/11/cuba-world-cup-respite-us-intervention))。
- **东耶路撒冷强拆**：巴勒斯坦人的家园被推平改建成公园，BBC报道当地愤怒情绪 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cewpwjr9rj4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))。
- **苏丹无人机袭击**：快速支援部队（RSF）被控在奥贝德袭击送葬队伍，人权组织谴责 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c70yeee2jvqo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))。
- **韩前总统尹锡悦判刑**：欧美媒体（NPR、Al Jazeera）均报道此案，指出其背景为引发朝韩紧张与戒严企图 ([NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/12/nx-s1-5856122/ousted-south-korean-president-yoon-prison-drone-flights-pyongyang))。

**【收束判断】** 特朗普的“口蜜腹剑”外交在伊朗问题上制造了短期市场兴奋，但缺乏实质落实，后续可能引发更大不确定性；世界杯成为全球地缘压力下的短暂“减压阀”，但古巴处境仍岌岌可危。
欧美.en:
The European and American desk is dominated by the unfolding Iran conflict narrative, with Trump's mixed signals on a deal creating market volatility and strategic ambiguity. Meanwhile, humanitarian crises in Sudan, East Jerusalem, and South Africa demand attention, alongside the symbolic opening of the World Cup in Mexico.

- **Iran War & Markets**: Trump called off strikes on Iran and touted a peace deal, sending Wall Street and Asian markets surging. However, Iran denied any final agreement, leaving the situation fluid. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/6/12/stocks-markets-surge-as-trump-calls-off-strikes-on-iran-touts-peace-deal?traffic_source=rss) | [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/videos/cz9lg5ywzvpo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Sudan Drone Strike**: A drone strike on a funeral in el-Obeid killed civilians, with rights groups accusing the RSF. This underscores the ongoing civil war's toll on civilians. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c70yeee2jvqo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **East Jerusalem Demolitions**: Palestinian homes are being demolished for a park, fueling anger. The practice raises legal and human rights questions under international law. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cewpwjr9rj4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **World Cup Opening**: The tournament started with a star-studded ceremony and protests, highlighting social tensions in host country Mexico. Cuba also hopes the World Cup will deter US military action. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c2ly928xz8go?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) | [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/11/cuba-world-cup-respite-us-intervention)

**Signal**: The combination of fragile cease-fire talks and ongoing violence in multiple hotspots suggests that the US-Iran dynamic will continue to dominate, but local conflicts remain deeply entrenched.

日韩.zh:
今日东亚最重磅事件当属韩国首尔法院判处前总统尹锡悦30年监禁，罪名是2024年派无人机飞越平壤以激化半岛紧张，为国内戒严铺路 ([Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1aREFFLVdaNk1Ic3pXSmU2QTlZSmRiRG1melNqSGFLZzFPb0pYQkdyY3h4Vk9BNkxPZUVwM1JHaEV0MWdMSloyU1BrNElFU3dFcEtaSHoxRQ))。日韩关系同步出现新动向：双方正协调在东京举行首脑峰会，同日召开经济安全论坛讨论供应链转移 ([조선일보](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxOMVI1U25PQ094dVlIWW9ac3hwUDdVTGZhNFRWTHhPeV9Mel9PNTN6N1hpdzV5Q3FyWkxWVWtIdEV5YlczeGxjLXpjeF9sdmh0OHVQYkhTa3JnVnd4Ylh6bEtrTVc3bFNZYUxMc3M5THU3dk5rb1RJTDk5Ym1DbkpvUWdMcmszcFRj))。在日本国内，日本足球队长远藤航因伤退出世界杯并宣布从国家队退役；一名高中女生遗体在东部发现，嫌犯被捕。此外，BTS新歌《Swim》获制作人评价“大胆但必要”，黄仁勋访韩希望被称为“K-Jensen”，AI企业竞争与韩国选举委员会遭搜查等事件亦受关注。
- **尹锡悦刑案**：法院判决30年，韩媒与欧美媒体（NPR、Al Jazeera）一致报道，强调其与朝鲜无人机事件及戒严企图的关联 ([Japan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxOV3FETWN0R1dzRHZPaEJNRnV0eWk5NGtBZjZObGV5WnduLXRUTDd0SGs1VFU4ZDNKWnVtUmdFcXhwVlJocjY5UTdieUFsRU9KSUJwU21pU2JJSnV3MHg5M2xlamt2R3RYcWhtSlY5WjgyaXFWNHI5RUJOQ0ZfSXRrZ3Q2MFVVNGdSR2I4djFGcUNZOEZyYU56Q01nUk5ocXZBN1JodFVNOUxTVlZIcUUyQTFhdVc2aUlqRTVB))。
- **韩日峰会协调**：双方拟在东京会晤，同时经济安全论坛探讨供应链变化 ([News On AIR](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxPZ0dGd1gtclNTeWpmY3BZWUV4NWZCRHZUWF81ekMwRUlzdUZPSDRsb0tZc0ptQk5rZncyN2FMRm55SDRNck1ZZl9kY3IyZTJYN2ZBWHVWWG5HVHg4Uk1nMzhhY1JuT1B3akxUekttcUJJOVRWUGJ2WXItZUJsc1c5bVJzQnRwUVU))。
- **日本社会案件**：17岁高中女生遗体被发现，警方逮捕一名男子 ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxNM0Z4TDhSNUlvS2ZnVTNVSW9FQVo0NjQwdU5Ka2FpYTExWHJpbjJMS25TQlRXSUI1WndsOGxzQ1NuY3VKTFJ4akRlT2ViYlliYmNnUmQ2T3ZZYWo5Wmo4QUJtY1J6SkFfWmdxMllvZ1ZGSzZ6VVVBZzc0NHIxZzBwNXZUMU03ZVp4Y1Iyek14T29ydw))。
- **BTS与AI跨界**：BTS新歌获评“必要冒险”，英伟达黄仁勋在韩表达文化亲和姿态 ([Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1xWjFlZ2ZtemE5anl0THFCUnM0UjBJT19KbUJmbnNHbmdlQ2VWRkI0OS13V3NjTjdfQjZwT2lKMWJKNjUzUzQxYjRQTHAyVXU3MjhBTmd6OA)、[Korea Herald另篇](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE5wSkNFcU56RHJKb1VaU2gzUm5WUllKUWxwS3N1MkRjM0UyMkQ0WHYxV1RvTDM2YXpKd1NnWFllWWVKRDNTUExsUHpjUkFJRThYcFhoVkJYTQ))。

**【收束判断】** 尹锡悦重判标志韩国司法对前政权“越线行为”的清算，短期内可能激化朝韩对立，但日韩峰会协调显示双方仍致力于稳定合作；日本社会安全事件与体育明星退役则折射出民众情绪脆弱性。
日韩.en:
The 16-item feed from the Japan-Korea desk is headlined by the severe sentencing of former South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol, which will have profound implications for domestic politics and inter-Korean relations. Other developments include a Japan-Korea economic security forum and a tragic murder case in Japan.

- **Yoon Sentenced 30 Years**: The Seoul court sentenced Yoon for sending drones into North Korea, a case that involved abuse of power and aiding the enemy. The verdict is unprecedented for a former president. [Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1aREFFLVdaNk1Ic3pXSmU2QTlZSmRiRG1melNqSGFLZzFPb0pYQkdyY3h4Vk9BNkxPZUVwM1JHaEV0MWdMSloyU1BrNElFU3dFcEtaSHoxRQ) | [Japan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxOV3FETWN0R1dzRHZPaEJNRnV0eWk5NGtBZjZObGV5WnduLXRUTDd0SGs1VFU4ZDNKWnVtUmdFcXhwVlJocjY5UTdieUFsRU9KSUJwU21pU2JJSnV3MHg5M2xlamt2R3RYcWhtSlY5WjgyaXFWNHI5RUJOQ0ZfSXRrZ3Q2MFVVNGdSR2I4djFGcUNZOEZyYU56Q01nUk5ocXZBN1JodFVNOUxTVlZIcUUyQTFhdVc2aUlqRTVB)
- **Japan-Korea Security Forum**: The two countries held an economic security forum addressing supply chain shifts, a significant move amid global trade uncertainties. [Chosun Ilbo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxOMVI1U25PQ094dVlIWW9ac3hwUDdVTGZhNFRWTHhPeV9Mel9PNTN6N1hpdzV5Q3FyWkxWVWtIdEV5YlczeGxjLXpjeF9sdmh0OHVQYkhTa3JnVnd4Ylh6bEtrTVc3bFNZYUxMc3M5THU3dk5rb1RJTDk5Ym1DbkpvUWdMcmszcFRj)
- **Planned Summit**: South Korea and Japan are coordinating a summit in Tokyo, which could ease bilateral tensions. [News On AIR](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxPZ0dGd1gtclNTeWpmY3BZWUV4NWZCRHZUWF81ekMwRUlzdUZPSDRsb0tZc0ptQk5rZncyN2FMRm55SDRNck1ZZl9kY3IyZTJYN2ZBWHVWWG5HVHg4Uk1nMzhhY1JuT1B3akxUekttcUJJOVRWUGJ2WXItZUJsc1c5bVJzQnRwUVU)
- **Violent Crime in Japan**: A man was arrested after the body of a 17-year-old high school girl was found in eastern Japan, highlighting ongoing safety concerns. [Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxNM0Z4TDhSNUlvS2ZnVTNVSW9FQVo0NjQwdU5Ka2FpYTExWHJpbjJMS25TQlRXSUI1WndsOGxzQ1NuY3VKTFJ4akRlT2ViYlliYmNnUmQ2T3ZZYWo5Wmo4QUJtY1J6SkFfWmdxMllvZ1ZGSzZ6VVVBZzc0NHIxZzBwNXZUMU03ZVp4Y1Iyek14T29ydw)

**Signal**: The Yoon verdict is a watershed moment for South Korea's democracy and will likely trigger political realignments, while the Japan-Korea diplomatic engagement suggests a pragmatic approach amid shared security challenges.

中国.zh:
今日中国社会新闻以“教育科研”与“文化传承”为主线。自然指数发布2026年科研领导者榜单，9所中国高校霸榜全球前十，连续霸榜彰显科研跃升势头 ([新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE5wRFBHeklSRzJLLXRQOU1KOF9Qc2ZpQXdCZTVOMGptSlRacV9iR2l6ZVJWUE1SMDVaUUhhTnpDOF9JVFAwa2pNMzB4cXdTNmRzcmRlc2hSR05CcThNOU1SYWExRVZtWWk3NVJXOHR1YmFOdDlGYzlMWGNPQVA2cmc))。国务院常务会议部署美丽中国建设，并定调未来五年教育发展关键信号 ([21财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxOcy1OSF82UmtPNUw4bWJhRGlnYXNHUWJrRVlRXzFWUVhkcVNVdGVoZkNmOUtjTVNlTmdoSDIwRGtOUGsxVlF0WVB0RWR4MUxZR2VfanRkUVhyRk1zNmRLWHZFaGFxZjRhY21DWnhKVEZJSXFzSGJxYjNRcnJrdFNXWE12dmFLRmpHWGsyZ0t4TQ))。上海电影节以“年轻力”为底色 ([新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxNRkNzM2FITXI2N09ldFF6bDFtV0JvZGZKS2lhZ01YdnBYOEZPbkJ2ODdsMHVBOXpHVVhpWlVVRzRqRXRFOUJpS2lPb3d3WXA5Si1GcllSZHhic1ktaXV3WVVCWW0tSFZxNGs1aUc5blNtMWY3ZnNWSHI1UWZSdjVlbF9SWQ))；高考招生季北京交通大学推出全新拔尖班。文化遗产保护领域，非遗“破圈”与技艺本真之辩引发讨论 ([中国社会科学网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE1yR1FPVnhwZk1WbXExb1p1eEFZOVJBQjROUGZHSkxOYjd3clItMW1GbEdLck5iRnV6LXhLZHdQTlFmWk5sODFPTW9rbTNYM0hDeFhNWlVDUUtfenhUUy1vTXp5cTFER2Q3ekZRUw))。此外，国家安全学自主知识体系建设研讨会召开，广东强调构建中国自主知识体系中的担当 ([南方日报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTFBBV0YyOWR4N2MwRm9rUGNpTVJ2blZ4WmpJdGs4RzY3TVVOcnF2eFVXSDBfZ2thNXVIN0RkSW1KTGVOdjAzNGtrRzZFVkp5aXl1cEoyd3h6Z2U3cjRwaHZzVHhMMXhLTDFiYlBvU3oxdGpZTkNZbzZFeUFR))。
- **科研榜单霸榜**：9所中国高校位列自然指数全球前十，新闻分析指出这反映中国科研投入与产出的长期积累 ([新华网分析](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE5wRFBHeklSRzJLLXRQOU1KOF9Qc2ZpQXdCZTVOMGptSlRacV9iR2l6ZVJWUE1SMDVaUUhhTnpDOF9JVFAwa2pNMzB4cXdTNmRzcmRlc2hSR05CcThNOU1SYWExRVZtWWk3NVJXOHR1YmFOdDlGYzlMWGNPQVA2cmc))。
- **教育政策信号**：国常会定调未来五年教育发展，涉及基础教育、职业教育与高等教育改革 ([21财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxOcy1OSF82UmtPNU4wWmdGa2w4cVBRM... 注意URL被截断，但原文本完整)。
- **文化传承讨论**：非遗“破圈”后如何保持技艺本真，学者与业界展开对话 ([中国社会科学网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE1yR1FPVnhwZk1WbXExb1p1eEFZOVJBQjROUGZHSkxOYjd3clItMW1GbEdLck5iRnV6LXhLZHdQTlFmWk5sODFPTW9rbTNYM0hDeFhNWlVDUUtfenhUUy1vTXp5cTFER2Q3ekZRUw))。
- **高考与青年**：北京交大拔尖班宣传，上海电影节聚焦“年轻力”，体现政策与市场对青年群体的重视。

**【收束判断】** 中国科研实力已获得国际量化认可，但如何将排名优势转化为产业创新仍需观察；教育改革与文化传承的讨论则指向社会发展的软实力需求，未来政策落地节奏值得追踪。
中国.en:
China's feed is heavily focused on education, research, and national policy, with less emphasis on breaking social conflicts. The highlight is the release of the 2026 Nature Index, showing nine Chinese universities in the global top 10 for research leadership. Other stories cover the State Council's education plan, a Shanghai film festival, and intangible heritage protection.

- **Nature Index Dominance**: Nine Chinese universities rank among the world's top 10 for research output in the 2026 Nature Index, reflecting sustained investment in science. [Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE5wRFBHeklSRzJLLXRQOU1KOF9Qc2ZpQXdCZTVOMGptSlRacV9iR2l6ZVJWUE1SMDVaUUhhTnpDOF9JVFAwa2pNMzB4cXdTNmRzcmRlc2hSR05CcThNOU1SYWExRVZtWWk3NVJXOHR1YmFOdDlGYzlMWGNPQVA2cmg)
- **State Council Education Plan**: The State Council outlined key signals for education development over the next five years, emphasizing reforms and talent cultivation. [21财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxOcy1OSF82UmtPNUw4bWJhRGlnYXNHUWJrRVlRXzFWUVhkcVNVdGVoZkNmOUtjTVNlTmdoSDIwRGtOUGsxVlF0WVB0RWR4MUxZR2VfanRkUVhyRk1zNmRLWHZFaGFxZjRhY21DWnhKVEZJSXFzSGJxYjNRcnJrdFNXWE12dmFLRmpHWGsyZ0t4TQ)
- **Shanghai Film Festival**: The 2026 Shanghai International Film Festival opened with a focus on 'young power' as its spiritual essence, signaling a push for youth-driven content. [Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxNRkNzM2FITXI2N09ldFF6bDFtV0JvZGZKS2lhZ01YdnBYOEZPbkJ2ODdsMHVBOXpHVVhpWlVVRzRqRXRFOUJpS2lPb3d3WXA5Si1GcllSZHhic1ktaXV3WVVCWW0tSFZxNGs1aUc5blNtMWY3ZnNWSHI1UWZSdjVlbF9SWQ)
- **Intangible Heritage Protection**: A discussion on how to preserve the authenticity of intangible cultural heritage amid commercialization ('breaking the bubble') appears in Chinese media. [中国社会科学网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE1yR1FPVnhwZk1WbXExb1p1eEFZOVJBQjROUGZHSkxOYjd3clItMW1GbEdLck5iRnV6LXhLZHdQTlFmWk5sODFPTW9rbTNYM0hDeFhNWlVDUUtfenhUUy1vTXp5cTFER2Q3ekZRUw)

**Signal**: China's focus on education and research excellence continues unabated, but social issues like heritage conservation and youth engagement are receiving more policy and media attention.

知乎社区动态.zh:
知乎社区今日舆情温度较低但暗含危机。首先，知乎母公司2025年财报显示营收同比下滑23.6%，CEO周源表示将加速AI商业化探索 ([财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ))，同时公司6月10日斥资9.54万美元回购股份以稳股价。但用户端体验却遇冷：工信部发文整治后，知乎“摇一摇”广告仍乱跳转，专家支招维权 ([搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQa1lLUnVfMUttbzBNRE1tWm5MTXpUbm5DdU9pa2pKMVhqQW45elRpZnhLMXpudmxwSW51bUh6Z2xnaWY4WG8xTHEzV3dJVU9Ra3ZBbWJTdHNiaG5mUFYzbGdyOVV6Qk80QUg3cndndFphSWlpYWZaeEtaT1VuYzRkTEhnc0wtem9xYXFyVw))。内容生态方面，“鹅腿阿姨”被举报后更多恶行被扒 ([VanPeople](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUEFVX3lxTE5sR3ZQMFFQRm50RmJXWGU5ajJaSmRYbEhPMHZSMGNpLUJZaXNFdFhobmQ4bWZWbUxhOXJDVFMtNE4xZnNvaFo5bkljbjBYREw3))，引发社区对网红乱象的讨论；短剧能否带网文生意亦成为行业焦点 ([Jiemian](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTE53cGFhMXBsQk9pQ2JWeC1fM3ZDUmJ2WE5ydGJJbGJycWs1UFJaNkh6VG1DaHZSSHlwNTQweXZrSkMyUGRCcVFfMzJ5QUs4eDNicTA5Sm9vc1g))。娱乐话题上，《乘风2026》四公张月情绪崩溃引发共鸣 ([360娱乐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE83alpENUtLZzZ3SU5uX3c0RXNrSmRWSEg0U1NQME1lUzYyUDRUVDR5ZkExX1FST2hWVzVwTzRtUjZIM0d3aXFBY2VSc2xOZlk))，杨紫电视剧热度以榜单形式传播。
- **知乎营收下滑**：2025年营收下降23.6%，AI商业化成救命稻草，但回购金额较小，市场信心仍需观察 ([财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ))。
- **摇一摇乱象**：工信部已发文整治，但知乎仍违规，专家建议用户投诉或关闭权限 ([搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQa1lLUnVfMUttbzBNRE1tWm5MTXpUbm5DdU9pa2pKMVhqQW45elRpZnhLMXpudmxwSW51bUh6Z2xnaWY4WG8xTHEzV3dJVU9Ra3ZBbWJTdHNiaG5mUFYzbGdyOVV6Qk80QUg3cndndFphSWlpYWZaeEtaT1VuYzRkTEhnc0wtem9xYXFyVw))。
- **鹅腿阿姨事件**：曾被追捧的网红被揭露更多不当行为，社区对“造神-毁神”模式反思 ([VanPeople](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUEFVX3lxTE5sR3ZQMFFQRm50RmJXWGU5ajJaSmRYbEhPMHZSMGNpLUJZaXNFdFhobmQ4bWZWbUxhOXJDVFMtNE4xZnNvaFo5bkljbjBYREw3))。
- **短剧与网文**：知乎、豆阅、小红书等平台探索短剧带动网文变现，商业模式可持续性存疑 ([Jiemian](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTE53cGFhMXBsQk9pQ2JWeC1fM3ZDUmJ2WE5ydGJJbGJycWs1UFJaNkh6VG1DaHZSSHlwNTQweXZrSkMyUGRCcVFfMzJ5QUs4eDNicTA5Sm9vc1g))。

**【收束判断】** 知乎正处于商业转型与用户体验的拉锯阶段，AI化是方向但广告乱象若不根治，用户流失风险将加剧；社区内容生态的“爆雷”事件则警示平台需加强审核与引导。
知乎社区动态.en:
The Zhihu community feed reveals a mix of platform scandals, business updates, and cultural discussions. A controversial figure known as 'Goose Leg Auntie' faces further allegations following a complaint, while the platform struggles with regulatory compliance on app permissions and a 23.6% revenue decline in 2025. Short drama and entertainment content also trends.

- **Goose Leg Auntie Scandal**: An exposé on 'Goose Leg Auntie' reveals more alleged misdeeds after initial complaints, indicating a deepening online controversy. [VanPeople](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUEFVX3lxTE5sR3ZQMFFQRm50RmJXWGU5ajJaSmRYbEhPMHZSMGNpLUJZaXNFdFhobmQ4bWZWbUxhOXJDVFMtNE4xZnNvaFo5bkljbjBYREw3)
- **Zhihu's Financial Woes**: Zhihu reported a 23.6% revenue drop for 2025, with CEO Zhou Yuan accelerating AI commercialization to reverse the trend. [财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NrQ2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)
- **Regulatory Issues**: Despite a government order, Zhihu and other apps still suffer from intrusive 'shake-to-open' ad redirects, prompting expert criticism. [搜狐网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQa1lLUnVfMUttbzBNRE1tWm5MTXpUbm5DdU9pa2pKMVhqQW45elRpZnhLMXpudmxwSW51bUh6Z2xnaWY4WG8xTHEzV3dJVU9Ra3ZBbWJTdHNiaG5mUFYzbGdyOVV6Qk80QUg3cndndFphSWlpYWZaeEtaT1VuYzRkTEhnc0wtem9xYXFyVw)
- **Short Drama vs. Web Novels**: A report examines how short dramas are affecting the web novel industry, with platforms like Zhihu, Douban, and Xiaohongshu adapting. [Jiemian.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTE53cGFhMXBsQk9pQ2JWeC1fM3ZDUmJ2WE5ydGJJbGJycWs1UFJaNkh6VG1DaHZSSHlwNTQweXZrSkMyUGRCcVFfMzJ5QUs4eDNicTA5Sm9vc1g)

**Signal**: Zhihu is at a crossroads: declining revenue and regulatory pressure force it to innovate with AI, while community controversies highlight the challenges of content moderation and user trust.

冲突局势.zh: **冲突局势**：乌克兰战争已超过一战时长（[NYT](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxPS3BCdEJRNk4xTnpES3pZX2pKalNEUWV2QllWSEFzZ3R1UUI2MTF3c1ZmUGZBS1Q5TkFmLXJjdDFHbUhiRXVydXZDcFZOejFCa3RzclFvX01xWjhpc3g2N2RkcTlidG05eVJmVkdMX2hWeW1iSEhveGR1LV8zQjVYMjdEME9uQQ)），而中东战场也持续恶化。乌克兰攻击克里米亚燃料供应引发半岛燃料危机（[104.5 WOKV](https://news.google.)），而俄罗斯则被研究指利用电影作为宣传武器（[mezha.net](https://news.google.com/rticles/CBMiZ0FVX3lxTFAyb285TUh0N1hYR3R0XzNPY1RjQlRTOTRab1psd3lEeE5ZZ2x2TWlXZmh2TnlrUjdWRWZJODM0c0U5VXZKVEJ1cVFIeXltS05lNDNBRlN3bWxIMGRYZzVsYzdYZ2pIUE0)）。北约宣布7月在安卡拉召开战争峰会（[WSWS](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE80MlR1ODVXcEY5ZmlWZXhpRDgwSE9GS2VmcFZKazFtaEJ5em9HcXAyRUkyM20wVnpoblFZRFgtd0dTaFgzRjR5Rms5OXI1M0pURGZSV2pDSDlZb0FFcGVKYTdIZ2hqT1VZ)），但欧洲仍希望拉特朗普入局和谈（[Kyiv Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTFBBekdIME9HQk1vUHQwNjZPMUhPT3NiQ2YxRTJvUVoyb0ZFZkNaN0JDS0FuR1VzeGc4SnBZT1NkbUdKdG96cXNOc3c0aw)）。此外，美国对伊朗的持续打击已导致全球航运评级被惠誉调至中性（[Hellenic Shipping News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxPYWhENlRQS1VCOTFqeXdnMkNENi1DTHhqSzlFdUloeENwb2VDLURTOE1fVEdmTnp0MC1RRVoxMV90OGp2eGZMdndxSzQwbHpGWWtvWVhmZjNJTXVmQnJMRmwxM2hHSnRyWkFxcllYUTFJY19ldWxOZFFsejBPbzNpMlVVWVpOYUZoR0REWWJDNGhselJjTTdsZ3VsVFdmdG5BTkkxTl9KTXhYWDBURWJlenhKcUtfMWdnNzg3c05ndm4)）。**收束判断**：多战线冲突的相互抵消效应正在削弱美欧的战略凝聚力，北约内部对和谈路径的分歧将成7月峰会核心议题。
冲突局势.en:
The conflict landscape is defined by simultaneous escalations: the US-Iran war has entered its second day of direct exchanges, while the Ukraine war surpasses World War I in duration. NATO is planning a summit in Ankara for July, signaling sustained alliance focus. Key developments:

- **US-Iran back-and-forth escalates**: On day two, US forces struck additional Iranian targets, bringing total damaged bases to over 50 ([BBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE5wXzRnSGZYakdxem5yWWkyRWthWG1ydHJzakd6Ri1IY09ZcG1GOEN2OWhUXzBIM0NXOVBaUEFDYnVMRXhfVG01blVWTF8zeVlHMnp5QVY3S2stZw)). Iran reportedly responded with retaliatory fire ([UPI](https://news.google.)).

- **Ukraine hits Crimea fuel supplies**: A strike on fuel storage has triggered a crisis on the occupied peninsula, disrupting logistics for Russian forces ([104.5 WOKV](https://news.google.)).

- **NATO summit in July**: The alliance will convene in Ankara for a “war summit,” likely to discuss further Ukraine aid and defense posture ([World Socialist Web Site](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE80MlR1ODVXcEY5ZmlWZXhpRDgwSE9GS2VmcFZKazFtaEJ5em9HcXAyRUkyM20wVnpoblFZRFgtd0dTaFgzRjR5Rms5OXI1M0pURGZSV2pDSDlZb0FFcGVKYTdIZ2hqT1VZ)).

- **War duration milestone**: The Ukraine war has now lasted longer than World War I, highlighting the protracted nature and its toll on resources ([NYT](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxPS3BCdEJRNk4xTnpES3pZX2pKalNEUWV2QllWSEFzZ3R1UUI2MTF3c1ZmUGZBS1Q5TkFmLXJjdDFHbUhiRXVydXZDcFZOejFCa3RzclFvX01xWjhpc3g2N2RkcTlidG05eVJmVkdMX2hWeW1iSEhveGR1LV8zQjVYMjdEME9uQQ)).

- **Shipping and economic effects**: Fitch changed global shipping outlook to neutral, citing war-led tanker rate surges ([Hellenic Shipping News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxPYWhENlRQS1VCOTFqeXdnMkNENi1DTHhqSzlFdUloeENwb2VDLURTOE1fVEdmTnp0MC1RRVoxMV90OGp2eGZMdndxSzQwbHpGWWtvWVhmZjNJTXVmQnJMRmwxM2hHSnRyWkFxcllYUTFJY19ldWxOZFFsejBPbzNpMlVVWVpOYUZoR0REWWJDNGhselJjTTdsZ3VsVFdmdG5BTkkxTl9KTXhYWDBURWJlenhKcUtfMWdnNzg3c05ndm4)).

**Signal**: The pace of US-Iran strikes suggests a deliberate escalation; a ceasefire looks increasingly unlikely, raising the risk of further maritime and energy disruptions.

国际安全.zh: **国际安全**：F-35战备率降至25%的严峻现实下，五角大楼寻求137亿美元追加投入（[Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/06/as-f-35-readiness-lags-pentagon-seeks-13-7-billion-boost-gao)），而美海军重启“武库舰”概念也反映远程打击能力的缺口。伊朗战场方面，美军已对50多个军事基地实施打击（[BBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE5wXzRnSGZYakdxem5yWWkyRWthWG1ydHJzakd6Ri1IY09ZcG1GOEN2OWhUXzBIM0NXOVBaUEFDYnVMRXhfVG01blVWTF8zeVlHMnp5QVY3S2stZw)），夺取哈尔格岛需1200人兵力（[Task & Purpose](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTFB2SW8wb1hhQUJsNjJtOHM5UExzUVVMMWJjNm1ERklCZ2NoTlZnTVZrUURMZm9RSjI0ZHRFRGlkMVZMeDd4V1paT0pPeWZGcW9aZHZIcnJkN0VqQmVVOWVWYkt2S2Y1R2Y5bnFuZQ)）。欧洲方面，波兰将领公开抱怨美国武器交付延迟，而美众议院已公布FY2027国防拨款法案（[Tectonic Defense](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxPb0FBc0gzejl4d2RQUzc5RWVWUWo0dlNJdnd1XzFjMmU0SXpxcXVMbU41ZmF1UDk1Q0JtbldZRjk1Y3FOWjN1aXFlYmtKX0ZzYVVIdHpXQ0ozTWtQVWpNVExoV3QyNzdXMWM2QXR1Q2FvY3pWZktEbEh0MjNKLXEyWDFaS2draURycEhZdnh0Tm5fUUE)）。挪威Kongsberg的“高-低”巡航导弹组合与美国2.4亿美元采购订单，显示美军正在低成本化精确打击方向发力（[TWZ](https://www.twz.com/air/kongsberg-bets-on-high-low-cruise-missile-mix-with-jsm-and-rusty-dagger)）。**收束判断**：美国军火产能与盟友需求之间的裂痕正在扩大，而小型化、低成本精确弹药正成为下一阶段军备采购的优选路径。
国际安全.en:
The international security desk is dominated by US military operations against Iran, F-35 readiness concerns, and European defense procurement dilemmas. The Pentagon’s budget request and congressional actions signal a major push for modernization despite systemic issues. Key developments:

- **F-35 readiness crisis**: The GAO reported the full mission capable rate fell to 25% in FY25, prompting a $13.7 billion Pentagon request to boost the program ([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/06/as-f-35-readiness-lags-pentagon-seeks-13-7-billion-boost-gao/)).

- **Iran strike damage assessment**: Satellite images confirm more than 50 Iranian military bases damaged since the conflict began ([BBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE5wXzRnSGZYakdxem5yWWkyRWthWG1ydHJzakd6Ri1IY09ZcG1GOEN2OWhUXzBIM0NXOVBaUEFDYnVMRXhfVG01blVWTF8zeVlHMnp5QVY3S2stZw)).

- **Kharg Island seizure debated**: Former military leaders and analysts outline what it would take to seize Iran’s key oil export hub; at least 1,200 troops would be needed ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/what-it-would-take-to-seize-irans-kharg-island-according-to-top-former-military-leaders), [Task & Purpose](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTFB2SW8wb1hhQUJsNjJtOHM5UExzUVVMMWJjNm1ERklCZ2NoTlZnTVZrUURMZm9RSjI0ZHRFRGlkMVZMeDd4V1paT0pPeWZGcW9aZHZIcnJkN0VqQmVVOWVWYkt2S2Y1R2Y5bnFuZQ)).

- **European defense procurement Catch-22**: Poland’s NATO representative warns of delays in US weapon deliveries, with new orders not arriving until 2029-2030 ([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/06/europe-facing-catch-22-over-us-weapon-sales-top-polish-general-warns/)).

- **Counter-drone and cruise missile developments**: MBDA showcased a hybrid laser-interceptor system for Germany ([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/06/mbda-showcases-hybrid-high-energy-laser-interceptor-counter-drone-system/)), while the US Air Force spent $240 million on Norwegian stealth cruise missiles ([National Interest](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQVTFYLUIweWdDU1lmXzRKal9EdlNMOHBTOVEzMXBnTmQ3emFVdWxRSHd0N29iUTh0cURIazhPQ253ckZrR0gtOXMxd1dhd3BvbXI4bEFkV1MyTVpva0NMNTkwTkNudTdXVVJlMnFza29ZMDhqRUZESnExQjM4REpiZWhDOHRVWDJZMmd5d0dwMVdHeWJHVGtLWDVIOGVwY1Q5M254bkZOLWFfTUJTb0FMaWt4amEzN3o0V0tad2taX0k)).

**Signal**: The combination of low F-35 readiness and long delivery timelines for allies reveals a critical capacity gap; the US may need to prioritize rapid-deployable systems like cruise missiles and directed energy to mitigate near-term risks.

海军与印太.zh: **海军与印太**：台湾本周成功试射HIMARS并展示“打了就跑”的战术能力，被视为对解放军两栖登陆的直接威慑（[USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/11/taiwan-tests-himars-missiles-on-islands-west-coast-in-major-live-fire-drills)）。美国海军在澳大利亚斯特林基地设立两个新司令部，为美英核潜艇轮换提供后勤支持（[USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/11/u-s-navy-stands-up-2-australian-commands-in-support-of-american-u-k-subs)），强化AUKUS框架下的水下力量。同时，美国在阿曼湾对涉嫌违反伊朗封锁的油轮发动打击，造成3名印度船员死亡（[USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/11/u-s-disables-3-tankers-as-part-of-iranian-blockade-3-mariners-killed-in-tuesday-strike)），凸显海上封锁的严酷性。法国发布未来舰载协作作战无人机（CCA）的RFI，瞄准新一代忠诚僚机（[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/france-issues-rfi-for-future-collaborative-combat-uav-with-carrier-capable-focus)）。韩华海洋被选定为韩国KDDX驱逐舰主承包商（[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/hanwha-ocean-selected-for-south-koreas-kddx-destroyer-program)）。**收束判断**：印太海军力量正在经历“无人化+高超声速”的双重技术革命，而台湾与南海的实战化部署进一步缩小了冲突触发阈值。
海军与印太.en:
Naval and Indo-Pacific activity surged, driven by the US blockade of Iran and Taiwan’s live-fire HIMARS tests. New submarine commands in Australia and South Korean destroyer contract awards signal sustained allied naval investment. Key developments:

- **US disables tankers enforcing Iran blockade**: Precision munitions disabled three merchant ships in the Gulf of Oman, killing three Indian mariners. CENTCOM says the vessels were violating the blockade ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/11/u-s-disables-3-tankers-as-part-of-iranian-blockade-3-mariners-killed-in-tuesday-strike)).

- **Taiwan conducts first HIMARS live-fire**: Taiwan’s army fired the M142 HIMARS on the island’s west coast, demonstrating long-range precision strike capability against potential amphibious assault ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/11/taiwan-tests-himars-missiles-on-islands-west-coast-in-major-live-fire-drills)).

- **AUKUS submarine support commands established**: The US Navy stood up Submarine Squadron 3 and another command at HMAS Stirling in Australia to support rotational US and UK submarines ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/11/u-s-navy-stands-up-2-australian-commands-in-support-of-american-u-k-subs)).

- **France issues RFI for carrier-capable combat UAV**: The DGA seeks industry input for a future collaborative combat UAV (CCA) system with a focus on carrier operations ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/france-issues-rfi-for-future-collaborative-combat-uav-with-carrier-capable-focus/)).

- **South Korea selects Hanwha for KDDX destroyer**: Hanwha Ocean outscored HD Hyundai for the detailed design and lead ship of the next-generation destroyer ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/hanwha-ocean-selected-for-south-koreas-kddx-destroyer-program/)).

**Signal**: The US is simultaneously enforcing a major maritime blockade in the Middle East while deepening its naval footprint in the Indo-Pacific; this dual-burden may stretch fleet resources, especially as Taiwan drills signal a higher readiness posture.

中国军情.zh: **中国军情**：美国参议院推进的国防授权法案将中国列为“侵略者轴心”，并授权建立台湾战时储备库（[美国之音](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxOUjctQmQ1cXdzMjh2SEFtTHEwS21JWHVpYmwySUozMjdWT2paOUJsQko1V1ZrZ0hUWUp1ZENSZTVTaTRQTTBBTzc3dXg2RkNSaGRTVHhoc2FmM01tTHFTdlRYSm81UG9WcFN5U1NpaDlMbVB2dW5IWnB3Tzc2Z1JBYkUxTjgxbG1LSno0MDh3d1dpUFV5NGJPb2FINW1fSTMzcW1LekdzNlpfTkNwUkw3ZGptZG5ReUJrZ0UwMg)），标志着对华战略竞争的制度化升级。与此同时，美国国防部将京东方等多家中国公司列入“中国军事企业清单”，相关企业声明并非军事企业（[新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE0yM3d3RlRYcVgxbjdFTjgyNDVieXdleG50dHpNNUJUcHExN1dWWEx0OXVUSHQtaGRCOERsdjl5c0ZSeHFyUHVQYXB1V005c2VuQVFuRF81d01fLWd1bHU5SGtNanRsSGEwWC05RWtFZXYtMU95YVE)）。南海方面，中国在南海的秘密施工被指为“让菲律宾更绝望的东西”（[搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPTk9naDYxZGh4S2VFd3JQeEJmd09OdGUzeTBXeGozQ25LU1Q3cTJ3MjVlQUxmckk2S2haalJTR3I3RktvTDhuQUlvWlQyS0lQZHh1WTdCdjljNFltY0Rsa1RFdzNzNDR5bkd4bGktZERPc0tYUzdkYnNkSHhnRy1EOW9Qb3RmWndSUDRIVA)），而菲律宾则宣布追加部署海岸警备艇（[朝鲜日报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNTTRUOW1JbGhUbXc0bEx0U3hYaXZrbWFMRVdkVWVDNk45ZnliQ09hRGVQNFZFV3VvaXE5WExPcnBteWdBSFItQ0pUWWJHSndFbS1FUjdnUy1OU0hDNHZ3a0xMWUV4bVRjNkJwVlh6c1NkMmFkNE5DYnIwcW5qR3NRQ0c0bkJvWkNnaUpfR3ozWEFFV09UbXItSA)）。**收束判断**：美国对华军事清单与立法行动正在制造业和科技企业领域制造“寒蝉效应”，而南海的基建与反制部署则使中菲之间形成“硬碰硬”对峙格局。
中国军情.en:
China-related military news focuses on South China Sea construction, US legislative moves labeling China an “aggressor axis,” and the Pentagon’s addition of Chinese companies to its military list. These actions underscore strategic decoupling and territorial friction. Key developments:

- **China’s secret South China Sea construction**: Reports indicate China is building something other than a military fortress, likely aimed at further constraining Philippine access ([搜狐网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPTk9naDYxZGh4S2VFd3JQeEJmd09OdGUzeTBXeGozQ25LU1Q3cTJ3MjVlQUxmckk2S2haalJTR3I3RktvTDhuQUlvWlQyS0lQZHh1WTdCdjljNFltY0Rsa1RFdzNzNDR5bkd4bGktZERPc0tYUzdkYnNkSHhnRy1EOW9Qb3RmWndSUDRIVA)).

- **Philippines deploys additional coast guard vessels**: In response, Manila is increasing its maritime presence in the South China Sea ([朝鮮日報](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNTTRUOW1JbGhUbXc0bEx0U3hYaXZrbWFMRVdkVWVDNk45ZnliQ09hRGVQNFZFV3VvaXE5WExPcnBteWdBSFItQ0pUWWJHSndFbS1FUjdnUy1OU0hDNHZ3a0xMWUV4bVRjNkJwVlh6c1NkMmFkNE5DYnIwcW5qR3NRQ0c0bkJvWkNnaUpfR3ozWEFFV09UbXItSA)).

- **US Senate NDAA targets China**: The defense authorization bill labels China as part of an “aggressor axis” and authorizes the establishment of a Taiwan war materials reserve ([美国之音](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxOUjctQmQ1cXdzMjh2SEFtTHEwS21JWHVpYmwySUozMjdWT2paOUJsQko1V1ZrZ0hUWUp1ZENSZTVTaTRQTTBBTzc3dXg2RkNSaGRTVHhoc2FmM01tTHFTdlRYSm81UG9WcFN5U1NpaDlMbVB2dW5IWnB3Tzc2Z1JBYkUxTjgxbG1LSno0MDh3d1dpUFV5NGJPb2FINW1fSTMzcW1LekdzNlpfTkNwUkw3ZGptZG5ReUJrZ0UwMg)).

- **CIA attempts to recruit Chinese cadres**: Reports claim the CIA is using anti-corruption campaigns as a cover to approach Chinese officials ([朝鮮日報](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxOR3kxcUdVMlViSkFYbFZsa2huR1c3UW5jMF8tSVdLS1BrSk9HMjU5NmYwNWktSkY0cmlJOUpEaE83MVpKZWFtZVR0RUJadzBhUk8yZkd3S0RhOGdvbTNQeGV2Q2w0N3dPenVYdWN6Nkx4aGVTMm03WUIwdUItX3JsQlpIbmRuYlF5d1lkZjFieHlmcXotSkIwUlVtWnVnMlFB)).

- **BOE and other firms added to Pentagon’s blacklist**: Multiple Chinese companies, including BOE, have been added to the “Chinese military company” list; they deny the allegations and defend their normal operations ([新浪财经](https://news.google.)).

**Signal**: The US is escalating its economic and legislative pressure on China, while Beijing continues low-level island-building in the SCS; the risk of a direct US-China confrontation in the Taiwan Strait or South China Sea is rising, though both sides still avoid kinetic action.

AI.zh:
AI行业正进入多事之秋：OpenAI降价、DeepMind预警、Anthropic呼吁监管、Prometheus巨额融资，四条线索指向同一个方向——AI正在从实验室竞赛进入基础设施级部署，风险与成本同步放大。

- **价格战一触即发**：OpenAI计划削减Token成本（[HOKANEWS](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxPVExiUkNhb1dSVllTdDNjY2hnejQ2Vks3ZWtHZkwyVjRXZGdYXzhSR1dXcUpEbEk0UHMyLU9uZ211NXNNbnpPTjdiWGNZQUxzOHZUZUN1c2RDcm9pM2ExNmhwWXRhaWJIRGdCLXlSZU1xbk9SZ3RwNnJNVlM0NThQUw)），此前DeepSeek已大幅压低推理成本，此举将加速中小模型厂商出清。
- **人才争夺升级**：OpenAI与Anthropic同步在伦敦大规模扩张（[streamlinefeed](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxNYmRSZVZGaUw2OHlFM1oya096WmpZMkxPN181aS02MkdGWnlnM0JUVFhLcEdDYlgtcnpQRE1sMi11bHVobW9mcExsS3pEdGpuLTNKa3hVc2M0bndTVGc5Y0pDQVhzVU5MN0YxQldlSG1qalVHdm1tTHhBSlMtRWpqSEpJMDNYaUxKYVBZVFVQQXVSTVNDbzFMYTAxc2JOSEJzVm13dzlEQzQyeTdNZVNZSjBBSFF4N0k)），英国脱欧后依然被视为AI人才高地。
- **多智能体安全成焦点**：DeepMind资助研究当数百万AI代理交互时的潜在危险（[MIT Technology Review](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/06/11/1138794/google-deepmind-is-worried-about-what-happens-when-millions-of-agents-start-to-interact/)），与此同时，一个AI代理因扫描DN42网络导致运营者破产（[Hacker News](https://lantian.pub/en/article/fun/ai-agent-bankrupted-their-operator-scan-dn42lantian.lantian/)），证明失控成本已非假设。

**判断**：AI行业正在进入价格和安全的双重敏感期，监管框架的建立速度将决定下一个十年的竞争规则——Anthropic已明确呼吁政府更强监管（[The Indian Express](https://news.google.)）。
AI.en:
The AI sector is in flux: a price war is brewing as OpenAI cuts token costs, while talent wars intensify with Anthropic and OpenAI expanding in London. Safety concerns are mounting after DeepMind warned about multi-agent risks and a new wrongful death lawsuit hit OpenAI. Meanwhile, Jeff Bezos's Prometheus raised $12B for physical AI, underscoring the divergence between digital and industrial AI.

- **OpenAI cuts token costs** — a move that could trigger a [price war](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxPVExiUkNhb1dSVllTdDNjY2hnejQ2Vks3ZWtHZkwyVjRXZGdYXzhSR1dXcUpEbEk0UHMyLU9uZ211NXNNbnpPTjdiWGNZQUxzOHZUZUN1c2RDcm9pM2ExNmhwWXRhaWJIRGdCLXlSZU1xbk9SZ3RwNnJNVlM0NThQUw). Lower API prices will squeeze competitors but could dramatically expand adoption.
- **DeepMind funds research** into the [dangers of millions of interacting AI agents](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/06/11/1138794/google-deepmind-is-worried-about-what-happens-when-millions-of-agents-start-to-interact/). The company's AGI safety lead warns unconstrained agent ecosystems pose systemic risk.
- **Anthropic pushes for tougher AI rules**, releasing a [safety framework](https://news.google.) that demands stronger government oversight — a contrast to OpenAI's earlier approach.
- **Prometheus raises $12B** at a $41B valuation to build an ['artificial general engineer'](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/11/jeff-bezoss-prometheus-raises-12b-to-build-an-artificial-general-engineer-for-the-physical-world/) for physical tasks, signaling a shift from chat to industrial AI.
- **Equal AI raises $30M** to screen calls for Indians, now with [over 1M monthly active users](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/11/equal-ai-raises-30m-to-screen-calls-so-indians-dont-have-to/) — a sign of hyperlocal AI services gaining traction.

**Closing signal**: The next 24 hours will likely bring more fallout from OpenAI's pricing move, including potential margin pressure on startups and a response from Google and Meta. Watch for regulatory announcements in the wake of the latest suicide lawsuit.

科技产品.zh:
今日科技产品领域无重磅硬件发布，但软件与服务层面有两个信号值得关注：Bluesky正式上线群聊功能（转向社区化战略），Oracle曝出被黑客利用的严重安全漏洞；此外，工厂机器人公司Theker获得8500万美元融资，预示通用型工业机器人可能成为新趋势。

- **Oracle安全漏洞影响超100家企业**：Oracle警告存在一个被黑客利用的安全漏洞，一个网络犯罪团伙声称正在利用该漏洞发起大规模黑客攻击，Google已通知超过100个存在潜在脆弱服务器的组织（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/11/oracle-warns-of-security-bug-that-hackers-abused-to-breach-100-companies/)）。企业级软件安全防线再次暴露短板。
- **Bluesky转向社群功能**：推出群聊功能（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/11/bluesky-launches-group-chats-as-company-shifts-focus-to-community-features/)），表明其试图与X/Twitter形成差异化，聚焦小圈子互动而非广播式信息流。
- **通用工厂机器人获资本认可**：Theker完成8500万美元融资（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/11/theker-just-raised-85m-to-build-the-factory-robot-that-doesnt-specialize-in-anything/)），其机器人可重新配置以执行多种任务，不同于专有形态的人形机器人，可能颠覆传统的产线自动化模式。

**判断**：科技产品的竞争正在从硬件参数转向软件生态与安全信任——Oracle的漏洞与Bluesky的功能更新都是“软件定义产品”的例证。
科技产品.en:
