The 科技产品 desk is flooded with coupon deals from Wired (Canon, Brooks, Paramount+, Hoka, LG, etc.), but there are real product stories: Theker raised $85M for reconfigurable factory robots, Oracle warned of a security bug abused to breach 100+ companies, Bluesky launched group chats, and Amazon refreshed its Echo Hub. A quirky innovation: researchers developed textiles that harvest drinking water from air.

- **Theker's $85M raise** for [reconfigurable factory robots](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/11/theker-just-raised-85m-to-build-the-factory-robot-that-doesnt-specialize-in-anything/) — a bet on flexible automation over humanoid robots.
- **Oracle security flaw** exploited by a hacking gang to [breach 100+ organizations](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/11/oracle-warns-of-security-bug-that-hackers-abused-to-breach-100-companies/). Google notified victims, and urgent patching is needed.
- **Bluesky launches group chats** as it [shifts focus to community features](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/11/bluesky-launches-group-chats-as-company-shifts-focus-to-community-features/) — a move to rival Mastodon and Threads.
- **Amazon Echo Hub gets a redesign** with [customizable homescreen and Ring AI](https://www.theverge.com/tech/948814/amazon-echo-hub-homescreen-redesign) — part of Amazon's push to make Alexa Plus more useful.
- **Water-harvesting textiles** from researchers — [a jacket that pulls drinking water from thin air](https://www.engadget.com/2192755/researchers-are-developing-textiles-that-can-produce-drinking-water-from-the-air/) — could have huge implications for outdoor gear and arid regions.

**Closing signal**: While coupon deals dominate, the underlying security breach at Oracle and Bluesky's feature pivot deserve attention. Expect more details on the Oracle hack timeline and patches.

HackNews社区动态.zh:
HackNews今日讨论热度集中在AI代理的非预期行为、人类注意力经济以及开发工具创新。FablePool项目（337分）试图用“众筹+公开构建”模式解决AI产品信任问题，而Claude Fable的过度主动引发对AI交互边界的反思。

- **FablePool：用资金池驱动AI公开构建**：用户将资金押注在某个Prompt上，Fable团队公开构建并交付（[Show HN](https://fablepool.com/)）。获得337分、180条评论，社区对新的AI开发协作模式高度关注。
- **Claude Fable过度主动引发争议**：Simon Willison发文称Fable“ relentlessly proactive”（[Simon Willison](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Jun/11/fable-is-relentlessly-proactive/)），288分、242条评论，讨论AI代理何时应该主动何时应该等待用户指令。
- **“如果你要求人类的注意力，请展示人类的努力”**：一篇关于人机交互设计的文章获得477分（[tombedor.dev](https://tombedor.dev/human-attention-and-human-effort/)），指出许多AI工具要求用户投入大量注意力却没有等价的价值输出，引发开发者共鸣。
- **“修复从未发生的问题不会获得认可”**：一篇2001年的经典论文被重提（[MIT](https://web.mit.edu/nelsonr/www/Repenning=Sterman_CMR_su01_.pdf)），297分、104条评论，讨论预防性维护在组织和软件工程中的困境。

**判断**：社区正在认真权衡AI代理的自主权与安全性，同时探索新的激励和信任机制——FablePool可能是众包+AI开发的一个有趣实验。
HackNews社区动态.en:
HackNews today is alive with philosophical debates and practical experiments. Top stories include a reflection on why 'nobody ever gets credit for fixing problems that never happened' (2001 PDF resurfacing), a Show HN for FablePool that pools money behind prompts, and a technical deep-dive on removing 'um' from speech. Claude Fable's 'relentlessly proactive' behavior sparked a 288-point discussion.

- **'Nobody ever gets credit for fixing problems that never happened'** [297 points](https://web.mit.edu/nelsonr/www/Repenning=Sterman_CMR_su01_.pdf) — a classic managing change essay that resonates with today's software maintenance culture.
- **Show HN: FablePool** — [pool money behind a prompt](https://fablepool.com/) and Fable builds it in public (337 points, 180 comments). A novel crowdsourcing model for AI-generated content.
- **Claude Fable is relentlessly proactive** [288 points](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Jun/11/fable-is-relentlessly-proactive/) — discussion highlights how AI agents that act without waiting can be both useful and annoying.
- **Removing 'um' from a recording** [41 points](https://doug.sh/posts/erm-a-local-cli-that-strips-ums-uhs-and-erms-from-speech/) — a CLI tool that runs locally, highlighting privacy-aware audio processing.
- **Show HN: Boo** — a [terminal multiplexer built on libghostty](https://github.com/coder/boo) (65 points) — new open-source tool for developers.

**Closing signal**: The FablePool concept points to a growing appetite for speculative AI funding, while the 'um' removal tool underscores the demand for lightweight, local AI tools. Watch for more Show HN projects pushing the edge of agent-based development.

汽车.zh:
汽车行业今日三大看点：固态电池首次在北美路测，标志EV技术瓶颈取得突破；Waymo推出付费会员计划，自动驾驶开始追求单位经济性；特斯拉FSD宣传视频自证违规，为其面临的高达145亿美元诉讼雪上加霜。

- **固态电池进入现实世界测试**：固态电池首次在北美搭载于电动汽车进行路测（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/11/solid-state-batteries-now-powering-evs-in-real-world/)），承诺更长续航、更快充电和更低成本，如果验证成功将改变EV竞争格局。
- **Waymo Premier会员每月30美元**：Waymo推出首个会员计划，提供优先接驾、10%返现和新城市优先体验（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/11/waymo-premier-membership-program-30-dollars-priority-pickups/)），这是自动驾驶运营商尝试精细化运营的标志。
- **特斯拉自己为FSD诉讼提供“证据”**：在官方宣传视频中，特斯拉展示了驾驶员在FSD开启时制作浓缩咖啡，以及FSD在丹麦多次违规行驶，这直接削弱了其“FSD仅为辅助驾驶”的法律辩护（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/11/tesla-promotes-fsd-misuse-official-videos-lawsuits/)）。
- **BYD 1500+马力跑车泄露**：BYD旗下腾势Z Roadster泄露，三电机1528马力，直接对标欧洲豪华跑车（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/11/byds-luxury-ev-roadster-leaks-1500-hp-headed-overseas/)），中国品牌加速高端输出。

**判断**：汽车行业的技术路线分化加剧——固态电池代表着底层创新，Waymo代表运营创新，而特斯拉的FSD争议则暴露了过度承诺的风险。
汽车.en:
A landmark day for EVs: solid-state batteries hit North American roads for the first time, BYD leaked a 1,528 hp luxury roadster and launched a sub-$22,000 plug-in hatch for Europe, and Waymo introduced a $30/month subscription. Tesla faces self-driving legal challenges, while solar manufacturing gets a boost in Georgia.

- **Solid-state batteries in real-world EVs** — [North American road testing begins](https://electrek.co/2026/06/11/solid-state-batteries-now-powering-evs-in-real-world/), promising longer range and faster charging. A potential inflection point for battery tech.
- **BYD's dual European push**: Leaked [Denza Z roadster](https://electrek.co/2026/06/11/byds-luxury-ev-roadster-leaks-1500-hp-headed-overseas/) with 1,528 hp targets luxury, while the [Dolphin G DM-i](https://electrek.co/2026/06/11/byd-dolphin-g-on-sale-65-miles-ev-range-for-22000/) plug-in hatch starts under $22,000. Both aim to capture market from European incumbents.
- **Waymo Premier membership** — [$30/month for priority pickups and 10% cashback](https://electrek.co/2026/06/11/waymo-premier-membership-program-30-dollars-priority-pickups/), inviting only frequent riders. A loyalty play as it scales toward 1M weekly rides.
- **Tesla's FSD troubles worsen**: Official videos show [FSD misuse](https://electrek.co/2026/06/11/tesla-promotes-fsd-misuse-official-videos-lawsuits/) (driver making espresso, traffic violations) undermining its legal defense against $14.5B in lawsuits.
- **HARIBO goes electric** — [gummy maker uses electric semi trucks](https://electrek.co/2026/06/11/gummys-go-green-as-haribo-turns-to-electric-semi-trucks/) for European deliveries, signaling industrial EV adoption beyond passenger cars.

**Closing signal**: Solid-state battery road tests will be closely watched for performance data. Expect BYD to officially unveil the Denza Z next month, which could shake up luxury EV pricing. Tesla's FSD video controversy may fuel regulatory scrutiny.

足球.zh:
世界杯正式开打，东道主墨西哥2-0击败南非，劳尔·希梅内斯从重伤中归来收获进球，感人至深。韩国队2-1逆转捷克，但空座率引发对赛事吸引力的质疑。场外转会动态密集：皇马官宣穆里尼奥二进宫，远藤航伤退并退出国家队，阿根廷补招塞内西。

- **[Mexico's Aguirre says Jiménez earned 'perfect day'](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49035727/aguirre-jimenez-perfect-day-mexico-goal)**：35岁的希梅内斯在世界杯首秀中破门，主帅阿吉雷称之为“完美的一天”。BBC以《从濒死到世界杯英雄》为题回顾了他2020年颅骨骨折的惊险经历。
- **[Hwang's magic sparks South Korea comeback win](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49037668/south-korea-overcome-czechia-via-hwang-beom-brilliant-display-world-cup)**：韩国队凭借黄仁范的出色发挥逆转捷克，但比赛在瓜达拉哈拉球场进行，数百个空座引发了对世界杯上座率的担忧。
- **[Liverpool's Endo out of WC, retires from Japan](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49032127/japan-captain-wataru-endo-world-cup-injury-announces-retirement)**：日本队长远藤航因伤退出世界杯并宣布退役，板仓滉接任队长。虎扑社区对此反应强烈，认为这是日本队备战重大打击。
- **[Poch: 'Too late' for motivational speeches for U.S.](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49035215/mauricio-pochettino-usa-world-cup-speech-paraguay-lineup)**：美国队主帅波切蒂诺表示“现在不是演讲的时候”，球队已准备好迎战巴拉圭。BBC调查发现许多美国人甚至不知道世界杯已经开始，主办国之一的美国存在“世界杯冷漠”现象。

世界杯首日战果已定，冷门不多，但红牌和逆转增添戏剧性。明日美国队与巴拉圭之战将检验东道主之一的竞技状态与民众关注度。
足球.en:
The 2026 World Cup is officially underway, and the opening match delivered fireworks: Mexico's 2-0 win over South Africa featured a record three red cards, while Raúl Jiménez's emotional goal capped his remarkable comeback from a near-fatal head injury. South Korea rallied to beat Czechia 2-1, though sparse crowds in Guadalajara are a concern. Off the pitch, Real Madrid's shock reappointment of José Mourinho and Japan captain Wataru Endo's injury-forced retirement reshape team dynamics ahead of a long tournament. Key stories:
- [Mexico opens WC with win after record 3 red cards](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49033183/mexico-south-africa-2026-world-cup-azetca-opening-game) — ESPN Soccer
- [From near death to World Cup hero - Jimenez's tears for Mexico](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cm2dl67rljvo) — BBC Sport
- [Hwang's magic sparks South Korea comeback win](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49037668/south-korea-overcome-czechia-via-hwang-beom-brilliant-display-world-cup) — ESPN Soccer
- [Real Madrid name Mourinho coach for 2nd time](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48814292/jose-mourinho-real-madrid-coach-alvaro-arbeloa) — ESPN Soccer
- [Liverpool's Endo out of WC, retires from Japan](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49032127/japan-captain-wataru-endo-world-cup-injury-announces-retirement) — ESPN Soccer

With the USMNT and Scotland playing their openers on Friday, expect further twists in the group stage; the early returns suggest a tournament defined by resilience and drama.

虎扑社区动态.zh:
虎扑社区今日围绕世界杯和NBA总决赛展开激烈讨论。C罗五届世界杯均有进球的纪录成为热门话题，而远藤航伤退引发对日本队的担忧。尼克斯惊天逆转后，美记调侃尼克斯罚球23-6却半场落后27分成为笑谈。此外，特里皮尔等狼队球员对主教练爱德华兹下课表示愤怒，折射英超更衣室动荡。

- **[C罗五届世界杯皆有进球历史最多](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5UT1ZoVzljd2hSN0M0TGp2VzRzVl9CbnBaSDhvT29wU2FITHluWUc0YnN1b3JPMmg5MHlzQWk4MmdGSUk1VVYtaFNrV3d1X2JlMjQ1RVJQT2lnLW4tR2R6QnBHOA)**：数据显示C罗在五届世界杯都有进球，超越克洛泽等前辈。该话题在虎扑引发“C罗与梅西历史地位”的对比讨论。
- **[日本足协：远藤航离开球队，板仓滉任队长](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9KY3NFVkl0S0FPSHl2RnNqOGNHdDl2dlRfMVAxX2FBT0I4RWFxTzhqT2JMcVhoX2tnRW9Ba2tHWlhuX3hleGJqOC0wdVJmcUg5MmFORmJYTWRhNldIUTBhS20tYw)**：虎扑网友普遍认为日本队世界杯前景蒙上阴影，并对远藤航突然退役表示惋惜。
- **[美记：最有趣的是尼克斯罚球23-6领先，却半场落后27分](https://news.google.)**：尼克斯罚球数远超马刺却一度大比分落后，最终完成29分大逆转，这一反差成为虎扑笑料。
- **[talksport：特里皮尔等数名狼队球员对爱德华兹下课愤怒](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE8tb3lKcTY5RUlYY2UtUEw5WTFvMEZwb2J5bmlvT0ZzMEp0c2RsMkVZQzZmVlBhT1ZpYUcxU1JrTmY5c282SVBqblhsbGFaRlVtZE03d1FB)**：狼队解雇主帅爱德华兹引发更衣室不满，特里皮尔等球员公开表达愤怒，虎扑用户讨论英超主帅的更迭频率。

虎扑社区今日情绪分化：世界杯带来激情，NBA逆转带来戏剧性，英超内讧则增添八卦趣味。明日美国队出战，预计将掀起新一波讨论。
虎扑社区动态.en:
The Chinese fan community is buzzing with World Cup discussions, led by a viral stat showing Cristiano Ronaldo has scored in five different World Cups – more than any other player. Japanese captain Endo's injury and retirement is a major talking point, while fans also debate the tactical strengths of Mexico and South Korea. Off the football pitch, a humorous NBA observation about the Knicks' bizarre box score (23-6 free throw advantage yet down by 27 at half) is circulating. Key highlights:
- [C罗五届世界杯进球纪录](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5UT1ZoVzljd2hSN0M0TGp2VzRzVl9CbnBaSDhvT29wU2FITHluWUc0YnN1b3JPMmg5MHlzQWk4MmdGSUk1VVYtaFNrV3d1X2JlMjQ1RVJQT2lnLW4tR2R6QnBHOA) — 手机新浪网
- [远藤航因伤退出世界杯](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9KY3NFVkl0S0FPSHl2RnNqOGNHdDl2dlRfMVAxX2FBT0I4RWFxTzhqT2JMcVhoX2tnRW9Ba2tHWlhuX3hleGJqOC0wdVJmcUg5MmFORmJYTWRhNldIUTBhS20tYw) — 手机新浪网
- [美记：尼克斯罚球23-6却半场落后27分](https://news.google.) — MSN

The community is clearly engaged with global events, blending stats and humor; expect continued debate as the World Cup group stage intensifies.

羽毛球.zh:
中国羽毛球队在澳大利亚公开赛第二轮表现强势，九场比赛全胜，其中男双梁伟铿/王昶力克印尼强档备受关注。同时，常州中国公开赛（超级750）公布国羽名单，石宇奇、陈雨菲领衔。此外，小将董天尧战胜周天成闯入八强，令人惊喜。

- **[2026年澳大利亚羽毛球公开赛第二轮综述：“梁王”力克印尼强档，中国队九战全胜](https://olympics.com/en/news)**：梁伟铿/王昶在男双比赛中击败印尼强档，成为当日焦点。国羽整体表现稳健，无一流失，展现出集团优势。
- **[国羽公开赛名单公布 石宇奇、陈雨菲在列](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5ydFBJSUVqMks2N2p4eUU4ZTZiUHo2RElSV1BFQUU0dU1wVkZDa3QwbDlKOFNqVlN5cldfWW1MY293T1JZcWE5UGFTWUlZTGRaVVBVNW8yNTZBNGRvSF9PdlhOMA)**：7月常州公开赛国羽报名名单出炉，男单石宇奇、李诗沣、翁泓阳、陆光祖；女单王祉怡、陈雨菲。总奖金200万美元，赛事级别为超级750。
- **[董天尧胜周天成晋级](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5IeVNBMUYzclhUUjlEZzU1b204WS00OHdZaGpPaFlHLS0tXzBuc2x1b3FGSmZEZ05hYnpnR01lQUtvNWRsdzVJdnFkOTh5cjUzZTVTOFAwTlNfMFNMemNjaGV6cw)**：中国小将董天尧在澳大利亚公开赛战胜中国台北名将周天成，爆出一个不大不小的冷门，显示国羽男单后备力量的成长。
- **[不负责任的裁判简直毁了这场比赛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE1LSGktTlk5bEo0bk43c29rOWRmMXpkMDhNZnZLcnc1NVpWNzlid29MMHhNaVNHMHY1bl83Skl3UjUxRHozQ3NOanhiYm9tUk5wLTl6QUN4MXV0eU0)**：亚锦赛（应为澳大利亚公开赛？标题称亚锦赛，但摘要中提及2026亚锦赛）出现裁判争议判罚，导致球员爆冷输球，引发球迷不满。该事件反映出赛事执法水平仍需提升。

国羽在澳大利亚延续强势，但需警惕裁判因素和体能分配。常州公开赛名单显示主力倾巢而出，为巴黎奥运周期后的新奥运周期蓄力。
羽毛球.en:
Chinese badminton continues to shine on multiple fronts. The team advanced all its players to the quarterfinals at the 2026 Australian Open (Super 500), with the men's doubles pair "Liang Wang" notably defeating a tough Indonesian duo. Off-court, news broke of the entry list for the China Open (Super 750) in Changzhou, featuring stars like Shi Yuqi and Chen Yufei. However, a controversial refereeing decision at the Asian Championships has frustrated fans, calling attention to officiating standards. Key items:
- [2026 Australian Open: China 9-0 in second round](https://olympics.com/...) — olympics.com
- [China Open 2026 entry list released](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5LR3RkSW14akRjeHM0TG9rYXRYNEx4dk00dnd5b2RtWFdTUkVZdUhGZzdUS2ZoWDdvdUlpeUs4STJTSDBZbXN0S19ubkFBUUZzN0M1UlJTemk5VmtJaWpoNVluZw) — 手机新浪网
- [Ref controversy: 'Unscrupulous referee ruined the match'](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE1LSGktTlk5bEo0bk43c29rOWRmMXpkMDhNZnZLcnc1NVpWNzlid29MMHhNaVNHMHY1bl83Skl3UjUxRHozQ3NOanhiYm9tUk5wLTl6QUN4MXV0eU0) — Mshale
- [Dong Tianyao beats Chou Tien-chen to advance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5IeVNBMUYzclhUUjlEZzU1b204WS00OHdZaGpPaFlHLS0tXzBuc2x1b3FGSmZEZ05hYnpnR01lQUtvNWRsdzVJdnFkOTh5cjUzZTVTOFAwTlNfMFNMemNjaGV6cw) — 新浪新闻

With the Australian Open quarterfinals set and the China Open approaching, Chinese shuttlers are in strong form; officiating reliability will be a subplot to watch.

篮球.zh:
NBA总决赛进入高潮，尼克斯在客场完成29分大逆转，目前3-1领先马刺，距离52年来首个总冠军仅差一场胜利。文班亚马在比赛中领到二级恶意犯规，累计积分濒临自动停赛，成为系列赛最大变数。詹姆斯近日重申“自己才是GOAT”，而尼克斯球迷在酒店外对文班亚马投掷鸡蛋，场外火药味十足。

- **[Knicks stage historic comeback, on brink of title](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49025502/knicks-brink-title-historic-comeback-vs-spurs)**：OG·阿奴诺比在终场前0.5秒补篮命中，帮助尼克斯以121-119完成总决赛历史上最大分差逆转（29分）。尼克斯全队赛后疯狂庆祝，距离队史第二冠（自1973年后）一步之遥。
- **[Wemby one point from suspension after flagrant](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49025108/wembanyama-issued-flagrant-one-point-away-suspension)**：文班亚马在第四节对布伦森的犯规被升级为二级恶意犯规（flagrant 2），直接驱逐出场。他的季后赛恶意犯规积分已达到3分（距自动停赛的4分仅差1分），若在剩余比赛中再领到一次一级恶意犯规将停赛。
- **[Knicks fans target Wemby with egg, jeers at hotel](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49031479/knicks-fans-direct-jeers-flying-egg-spurs-victor-wembanyama)**：赛后文班亚马回酒店时遭遇尼克斯球迷围堵，有人朝他投掷鸡蛋但未击中。纽约警方已加强安保，马刺方面对此表示谴责。
- **[LeBron on GOAT debate: Taking nobody over me](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49019758/lebron-james-goat-debate-not-taking-me)**：勒布朗·詹姆斯在最新采访中回应GOAT之争，直言“我不会选任何人超过我自己”。该言论在虎扑和推特上引发激烈争论。
- **[Get ready for a wild NBA offseason: 10 teams to watch](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49013444/nba-offseason-2026-lebron-lakers-giannis-bucks-heat-thunder-10-most-interesting-teams)**：ESPN在总决赛期间提前展望休赛期，列出10支可能引发市场动荡的球队，包括湖人（詹姆斯未来）、雄鹿（字母哥去留）、热火等。

尼克斯距离冠军一步之遥，但文班亚马的停赛危机可能让系列赛再生悬念。第五场将回到圣安东尼奥，马刺若能在主场扳回一城，压力将重返尼克斯一边。休赛期大幕已悄然拉开。
篮球.en:
The NBA Finals have delivered one of the most stunning games in league history: the New York Knicks erased a 29-point fourth-quarter deficit to beat the San Antonio Spurs in Game 4, taking a 3-1 series lead. Victor Wembanyama now walks a tightrope after collecting a flagrant foul that leaves him one point away from a suspension. Off the court, Knicks fans greeted Wembanyama at his hotel with jeers and a thrown egg. LeBron James, meanwhile, added fuel to the GOAT fire. The offseason looms with uncertainty around superstars. Key links:
- [Knicks stage historic comeback, on brink of title](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49025502/knicks-brink-title-historic-comeback-vs-spurs) — ESPN
- [Wembanyama one point from suspension after flagrant](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49025108/wembanyama-issued-flagrant-one-point-away-suspension) — ESPN
- [Knicks fans target Wemby with egg, jeers at hotel](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49031479/knicks-fans-direct-jeers-flying-egg-spurs-victor-wembanyama) — ESPN
- [LeBron on GOAT debate: Taking nobody over me](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49019758/lebron-james-goat-debate-not-taking-me) — ESPN
- [Get ready for wild NBA offseason: 10 teams to watch](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49013444/nba-offseason-2026-lebron-lakers-giannis-bucks-heat-thunder-10-most-interesting-teams) — ESPN

The Knicks can clinch their first title in over 50 years in Game 5; the Spurs must deal with the fallout of a historic collapse and a star center facing potential suspension.

欧美.zh:
今日欧美娱乐新闻以斯皮尔伯格新片开画和音乐人获奖/发片为主线。76岁名导的科幻片《Disclosure Day》全球首日仅收1200万美元，远低于其过去作品首映表现，市场对其能否靠口碑回温存疑。与此同时，Taylor Swift获选入词曲创作者名人堂，21分钟演讲展现其真诚一面；Olivia Rodrigo第三张专辑获乐评一致赞誉，风格转向新浪潮，合作Robert Smith被视作跨界重要一步。此外，Seth Meyers调侃特朗普错过Knicks比赛，Tom Hanks反对增设奥斯卡配音奖项，显示业内对奖项改革的分歧。
- [斯皮尔伯格《Disclosure Day》首日票房仅1200万，海外与北美各半](https://deadline.com/2026/06/box-office-disclosure-day-1236954426/)，与《头号玩家》同期相比缩水明显。
- [Taylor Swift含泪致谢家人，称“你们是我今晚在这里的原因”](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/taylor-swift-songwriters-hall-of-fame-acceptance-speech-1236779180/)。
- [Olivia Rodrigo新专辑获《Variety》和《Rolling Stone》双好评，被形容为“最动人的爱情故事”](https://variety.com/2026/music/album-reviews/olivia-rodrigo-album-review-pretty-sad-for-girl-so-in-love-1236778775/)。
- [Tom Hanks认为奥斯卡无需设立配音奖项，称“现有奖项已足够”](https://deadline.com/2026/06/tom-hanks-oscars-dont-need-voice-actor-category-1236954494/)。
- [《Off Campus》剧组警告骚扰者将被移除社交账号](https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/off-campus-online-harassment-season-two-cast-1235576496/)，反映网暴已从粉丝圈蔓延至职业剧组。

总体看，欧美娱乐业在票房、音乐、奖项话语权三个维度同时展开角力，斯皮尔伯格的市场号召力遭遇挑战，而音乐界正迎来新代际交替。
欧美.en:
Hollywood is buzzing with mixed signals: Spielberg's 'Disclosure Day' underperforms expectations, while Taylor Swift and Olivia Rodrigo dominate music headlines. The industry also sees commentary on voice-acting Oscars and rising filmmaker awards.

- [Steven Spielberg’s ‘Disclosure Day’ First Day Global Cume Around $12M](https://deadline.com/2026/06/box-office-disclosure-day-1236954426/) — The alien feature's $12M opening day is soft for a Spielberg film, raising questions about its weekend trajectory.
- [Taylor Swift Tears Up at Songwriters Hall of Fame](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/taylor-swift-songwriters-hall-of-fame-acceptance-speech-1236779180/) — Swift's induction underscores her songwriting legacy; the emotional 21-minute speech trended globally.
- [Olivia Rodrigo Album Receives Rave Reviews](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-album-reviews/olivia-rodrigo-you-seem-pretty-sad-for-a-girl-love-review-1235576485/) — Both Rolling Stone and Variety call the album a career peak, with New Wave influences and a collaboration with Robert Smith.
- [Tom Hanks Thinks Oscars Don’t Need Voice Actor Category](https://deadline.com/2026/06/tom-hanks-oscars-dont-need-voice-actor-category-1236954494/) — Hanks argues voice actors can win in existing categories, reigniting debate on Academy recognition.
- [Sony Future Filmmaker Awards Announces 2026 Winners](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/sony-future-filmmaker-awards-2026-winners-1236779349/) — Winners include Jack Hughes and Christine Seow, highlighting emerging talent.

European festival news: Karlovy Vary adds 'Trainspotting' retrospective. The mix of legacy and new voices signals a healthy industry transition.

日韩.zh:
日韩娱乐今天以新剧物料和音乐节阵容为主，折射出下半年K-content的密集布局。SBS夏季歌谣大战首批阵容涵盖NCT泰容、DAY6元弼、ATEEZ等一线偶像，预示暑期音综竞争白热化。戏剧方面，金明洙与姜敏雅主演的《Love in Sync》接连释出预告和海报，浪漫喜剧元素之外“情感共享”的超现实设定引发期待；南宫珉新剧《The Husband》发布特别海报，讲述丈夫营救被绑妻子的惊险故事；李准Ho正商谈出演水神题材新剧，若成行将是他继《衣袖红镶边》后的又一古装大戏。此外，Crunchyroll与索尼联合讨论动画电影全球票房增长趋势，强化日韩动漫IP的国际输出。
- [SBS夏季歌谣大战首批阵容公布，含NCT泰容、ATEEZ、RIIZE等12组](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847356wpp/2026-sbs-gayo-daejeon-summer-announces-1st-artist-lineup)。
- [《Love in Sync》新预告：顶级明星姜敏雅向金明洙请教演技](https://www.soompi.com/article/1846973wpp/watch-top-star-kang-min-ah-seeks-counseling-from-kim-myung-soo-to-improve-her-acting-in-love-in-sync-teaser)。
- [南宫珉《The Husband》海报：医生面对绑架妻子的罪犯](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847294wpp/namkoong-min-faces-off-against-his-wifes-kidnapper-in-the-husband)。
- [李准Ho收到新剧《怪物大使馆》出演提案，饰演水神](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847277wpp/lee-junho-in-talks-for-new-rom-com-drama)。
- [Crunchyroll与索尼探讨动画电影全球院线增长](https://news.google.)，标志日本动画不再满足于本土市场。

K-content正同时发力音乐节、新剧连载及国际发行，但需注意近期韩剧题材同质化（复仇、奇幻、超现实）可能引发审美疲劳。
日韩.en:
The K-drama and K-pop pipeline remains robust, with new trailers, casting news, and festival lineups. SBS Gayo Daejeon Summer promises a stacked artist roster, while several romantic comedies and thrillers gear up for release.

- [2026 SBS Gayo Daejeon Summer Announces 1st Artist Lineup](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847356wpp/2026-sbs-gayo-daejeon-summer-announces-1st-artist-lineup) — NCT’s Taeyong, ATEEZ, ZEROBASEONE, and RIIZE lead the first wave; more acts to be revealed.
- [Watch: Top Star Kang Min Ah Seeks Counseling From Kim Myung Soo To Improve Her Acting In “Love In Sync” Teaser](https://www.soompi.com/article/1846973wpp/watch-top-star-kang-min-ah-seeks-counseling-from-kim-myung-soo-to-improve-her-acting-in-love-in-sync-teaser) — New teaser for the rom-com shows a unique premise of emotion sharing; chemistry between leads is highlighted.
- [Nam Joo Hyuk’s “The East Palace” Announces Premiere Date With First Poster](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847273wpp/nam-joo-hyuks-the-east-palace-announces-premiere-date-with-first-poster) — The ghost-themed historical drama sets a premiere date; Nam Joo Hyuk plays a man who can traverse the ghost world.
- [Lee Junho In Talks For New Rom-Com Drama](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847277wpp/lee-junho-in-talks-for-new-rom-com-drama) — Lee Junho may star as a water deity in 'Embassy for Foreign Monsters in Korea', adding to his drama slate.
- [Shin Ha Kyun And Heo Sung Tae Raid Drug Smuggling Site In “Fifties Professionals”](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847301wpp/shin-ha-kyun-and-heo-sung-tae-raid-drug-smuggling-site-in-fifties-professionals) — Action-comedy continues its run; new stills show high-stakes raid.

K-pop idols are also making fashion waves with summer colors. The Korean entertainment machine shows no sign of slowing down as fans anticipate June premieres.

微博社区动态.zh:
微博社区今日被白鹿维权和迪丽热巴绯闻两大话题主导。白鹿工作室澄清起诉流程——先告平台要求披露账号，再酌情追诉诽罪，此举旨在遏制黑粉造谣的源头，获得粉丝力挺。迪丽热巴与陈飞宇的恋情传闻则掀起更大波澜：网友扒出两人同款手链、衣物，甚至“巴黎偷看”细节，但热巴方迅速辟谣杂志消息，部分用户质疑“被拉来挡枪”，舆论呈现“别乱磕”与“真情侣”对立。此外，谢娜北京演唱会近2万张门票秒罄，证实其跨界演出号召力；于娜自曝因焦虑症暴食至230斤，引发对艺人心理健康的关注。豆包开启付费模式虽属科技新闻，但在娱乐板块也因影响泛娱乐创作而受讨论。
- [白鹿告平台求披露账号，粉丝呼吁勿误读“名誉权起诉”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9TVzlxSEU3Z3RYcnRMQ0ZRYzVJRExnd2U1bzlUWWpBWUxfN3JmTEpBVTlVV1FDaTEyaHM5NnBqQ3VjMlZQQk1iNkN1WFdfY292Y1llVG1TSHNfMTJFdWJrMmFJaw)。
- [迪丽热巴陈飞宇被传秘恋一年半，粉丝急喊“别乱磕”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTE12YnpwWW1HWGR5ajUxeVZxcVBnaE5qVDFEZjJrMkoxVUJVMVBwdnprbExqckR6ekRHM0xwbEFrZG9yYUt5RUg3Z1R5MDlsT2tKTEE)。
- [谢娜北京演唱会近2万张门票秒罄，跨界演出引热议](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQUHJRSnVQeGFQeG1EQ3lncktrS3A1dDRoeGluZVhIcVIwejJ3TmdWWm12a3lmZ2R5TFdUUEtYV0FWUTcyWjFGazJUWElCek10RFJBUF96MDVTTk1TNHpFc01Dd0YzUERMZlJmSWo0X0pKOGdrTk9SVTI4aVNDZ0hLa2NReEtUWDJwcGV6Vg)。
- [于娜自曝焦虑症暴食至230斤，情绪性饮食问题引关注](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE5fSThNUnRvRGNVRHlkQlJUSG1OZjVlUlpDbGlRc2p6NzczWmYzU2k4UFgyWVM0S3RNZUdmNkdOZmxnQi03UXI2T3gtTllwRWt4ZnlDa2Y5RUl2VVdPV2dLSUJpWWJ6dHBYWjUyaDRtRG0)。

微博社区今天显示两个趋势：一是明星维权从“告黑粉”升级为“告平台”，法律路径更精准；二是绯闻传播中粉丝与路人认知冲突加剧，“挡枪论”消耗公众信任。
微博社区动态.en:
Chinese social media is dominated by celebrity gossip and legal battles. Bai Lu's defamation lawsuit against Weibo and Douyin, Dilireba and Chen Feiyu dating rumors, and Xie Na's sold-out concert are top trending topics. A rumor about AI assistant Doubao going paid also stirs discussion.

- [白鹿起诉9人侵犯名誉权](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9TVzlxSEU3Z3RYcnRMQ0ZRYzVJRExnd2U1bzlUWWpBWUxfN3JmTEpBVTlVV1FDaTEyaHM5NnBqQ3VjMlZQQk1iNkN1WFdfY292Y1llVG1TSHNfMTJFdWJrMmFJaw) — Bai Lu is suing nine individuals for defamation, demanding platforms disclose user information before pursuing criminal charges. This highlights growing celebrity efforts to combat online harassment.
- [迪丽热巴陈飞宇被爆秘恋1年半上热搜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTE12YnpwWW1HWGR5ajUxeVZxcVBnaE5qVDFEZjJrMkoxVUJVMVBwdnprbExqckR6ekRHM0xwbEFrZG9yYUt5RUg3Z1R5MDlsT2tKTEE) — Rumors of a 1.5-year secret relationship between Dilireba and Chen Feiyu erupt, with fans analyzing matching accessories. Multiple posts deny or confirm, reflecting a polarized fanbase.
- [秒空！谢娜演唱会近2万张门票售罄！](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQUHJRSnVQeGFQeG1EQ3lncktrS3A1dDRoeGluZVhIcVIwejJ3TmdWWm12a3lmZ2R5TFdUUEtYV0FWUTcyWjFGazJUWElCek10RFJBUF96MDVTTk1TNHpFc01Dd0YzUERMZlJmSWo0X0pKOGdrTk9SVTI4aVNDZ0hLa2NReEtUWDJwcGV6Vg) — Xie Na's Beijing concert sold out instantly, sparking debate about cross-over artists entering the live music scene.
- [豆包将开启付费模式 已官宣三档收费标准](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE05YXRaWDFRMVdWU3JodUVmRnQ4b29WeFkwSk4yOW5ZNXAtQm9QempwNVhBYjkwZkFDZ3doSUh4VlptenFmMm9GTHZkUFdlSzhzd09Tc3NDa1BQVGJuUW1tbFF4Q3BwQXBxc2c4RXlGdUQ4U1NIdEZfTg) — Doubao, a popular AI assistant, announces a three-tier paid model, drawing consumer attention amid rising AI monetization.
- [于娜透露自己焦虑症长期服药加上情绪性暴食 最胖时达到230斤](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE5fSThNUnRvRGNVRHlkQlJUSG1OZjVlUlpDbGlRc2p6NzczWmYzU2k4UFgyWVM0S3RNZUdmNkdOZmxnQi03UXI2T3gtTllwRWt4ZnlDa2Y5RUl2VVdPV2dLSUJpWWJ6dHBYWjUyaDRtRG0) — Actress Yu Na opens up about her struggle with anxiety and binge eating, normalizing mental health conversations in the industry.

These stories reflect a Chinese internet that is simultaneously obsessed with celebrity lives, legal accountability, and emerging tech trends.

中国.zh:
中国娱乐新闻以第28届上海国际电影节开幕为最大亮点，同时伴有产业政策利好与国际争议。SIFF今日开幕，强调“世界首映”集萃和影视IP线下场景拓展，第三届电影金数字荣誉在重庆同步颁发，数字化标准发布标志着行业基础设施升级。商务部点名网文、网剧、网游为文化出海新引擎，与电影节“链接未来”主题呼应。但Lisa被曝将亮相世界杯演出引发国内争议——部分网民质疑为何中国女星未获同等机会，折射出中国娱乐产业国际话语权焦虑。此外，韩媒报道金秀贤、李敏镐身价仅为成龙一半，对比鲜明。黄晓明“成功上岸”圆梦的新闻则更偏个人向。
- [第28届上海国际电影节开幕，荟萃世界首映](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiTkFVX3lxTE9wUmdMenVYZVYwLUFYOE14b1dBTVQ5VFJQSFVwa0hJQXBrdkhncTZuTlFGS25Tc3BUV0pWZ2tNOEtDVzY4SmgwYlJYSEtSdw)。
- [商务部：网文、网剧、网游成文化消费和出海新引擎](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxPM0Q1emVuNmZNdjNpT0xxdjVHbmI5UTFpQVFfanBxTkRabnZCcGcxV2NfcjNtWlQtaVZibGJuLUJKNjJKVXJESlhjeUFjS2hCekZOZVY3R0JEaG1MVzJmNFFaUkJSN2FBWnd6alg1NC1HdHROZ0l0NmVvbTBPejh6eFdSZTFlLUJqbHN0Zjg1SQ)。
- [#李登科曝Lisa世界杯不靠三公子#引发讨论，网民质问“中国女星为何不行”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE02b2FIUm9uem5yYUcwMnR6dzRybFF5dndyMldxZ2ViUGVib085cWwzOW1DN25LZjRfMzA1WnZ3M1BSUDEzZVU1Skl6NWk4bkpON0xMdDlsU3hjQVBJOGlTX0d5UQ)。
- [韩媒称金秀贤李敏镐身价仅为成龙一半](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxORjZJaldzWW41V2tlNlRYRnFWcGZKQUthWWNqTVlJUkJ1a1VGdUEtMXdiZGNTS2poQmExUlNPanpYcW56Y2tJcXJqY1VRVTU5c2hpdnJfbUVGcXZTOHo3dE51czlTU1VyMVZPaWZrNHdtZmJSTXFwS25vdXdhOEd3dElJR0xLLUs4dWY4M3lFX1p4aHRYdVNEYw)，显示中国艺人在亚洲市场的头部溢价能力。
- [金数字荣誉推荐揭晓，可灵AI、《飞驰人生3》等16项目获奖](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE5kUGppOGkxOWJaZXBZaEZ6OFV3bXZTbFhBWnNFZjZYYnZ0LThlU19pN18xVVluN2Uza3kyaGxSZW5UemZDZVZyajFQdXQ2cmV4SGppamx5QjBnREhQUEk5VEFpZ3p2SXhLWHo4)，数字化标准同步发布。

中国娱乐产业正同时经历政策利好（出海鼓励、电影节繁荣）与舆论挑战（国际舞台缺席焦虑），如何将内容产能转化为全球影响力，是本届上海电影节的核心命题。
中国.en:
China's entertainment industry is focused on the Shanghai International Film Festival (SIFF) opening, digital film standards, and the Ministry of Commerce naming web novels, dramas, and games as key export drivers. A controversy over Lisa performing at the World Cup sparks nationalist sentiment online.

- [上海国际电影节今天开幕，这里的每一处都将与电影深深呼应](https://www.thepaper.cn) — The 28th SIFF opens with world premieres and discussions on the future of film in a digital age. It is a key barometer for Chinese cinema's post-pandemic recovery.
- [商务部：中国网文、网剧、网游成文化消费和出海新引擎](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxPM0Q1emVuNmZNdjNpT0xxdjVHbmI5UTFpQVFfanBxTkRabnZCcGcxV2NfcjNtWlQtaVZibGJuLUJKNjJKVXJESlhjeUFjS2hCekZOZVY3R0JEaG1MVzJmNFFaUkJSN2FBWnd6alg1NC1HdHROZ0l0NmVvbTBPejh6eFdSZTFlLUJqbHN0Zjg1SQ) — The Ministry of Commerce officially recognizes web novels, web dramas, and online games as new growth areas for cultural consumption and exports, signaling government support.
- [#李登科曝Lisa世界杯不靠三公子#这话我不爱听](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE02b2FIUm9uem5yYUcwMnR6dzRybFF5dndyMldxZ2ViUGVib085cWwzOW1DN25LZjRfMzA1WnZ3M1BSUDEzZVU1Skl6NWk4bkpON0xMdDlsU3hjQVBJOGlTX0d5UQ) — A commentator claims Lisa's World Cup performance is due to her own talent, not her boyfriend; Chinese netizens react with nationalistic anger, questioning why Chinese stars are not chosen.
- [第三届电影金数字荣誉推荐揭晓，影视基地数字化行业标准同步发布](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE5kUGppOGkxOWJaZXBZaEZ6OFV3bXZTbFhBWnNFZjZYYnZ0LThlU19pN18xVVluN2Uza3kyaGxSZW5UemZDZVZyajFQdXQ2cmV4SGppamx5QjBnREhQUEk5VEFpZ3p2SXhLWHo4) — Awards recognize 16 projects including Kling AI and 'Pegasus 3'; new digital standards for film bases are released, pushing industry modernization.
- [黄晓明成功“上岸”！终于圆梦！](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTFBXdElFTVN5cThVZXhwV29aOUk2SXB6YWNuRTRpbHpyUF9nejZNVFJ5b0RoYUNGejBBTVVSRzJlT1AySzdaRFZvUDM1empmYXJvNWNPZDA0enljU05MVzhKVVdrSEYtUjJnT3pVUUx0bXhIRk1WdzhFMw) — Huang Xiaoming reportedly achieves a long-held dream (likely a new film or role), trending on Weibo with positive sentiment.

SIFF and the digital standards event in Chongqing show China's dual focus on content and infrastructure, while the Lisa controversy reveals underlying cultural tensions in global entertainment.
